papers.title: Latent Compaction with Test-Time Training
papers.summary: Long contexts enlarge key--value (KV) caches, increasing memory use and attention costs during generation. Compressing these caches must preserve information for unseen questions. We introduce **Latent Compaction**, which learns a compact document-specific cache through test-time training. We initialize cache entries using reconstruction importance, teacher attention, and key-space diversity. Training first fits attention outputs and log-normalizers to those of the full cache, with reconstruction-selected entries held fixed. It then jointly optimizes the entire cache through end-to-end distillation from the full-cache model. Model weights remain frozen throughout, and training uses only generic prompts about the document, without access to downstream questions or answers. Experiments on RULER, LongBench, and Phonebook Lookup demonstrate substantial gains over budget-matched compression baselines. On a RULER, for example, our method achieves 96.7% accuracy at 32$\times$ compression, compared with 40.0% for KVZip+. The method also transfers across model scales and families, with retrieval gains on both Qwen3 and MiniCPM5. These results show that treating the KV cache as a neural network and optimizing it with test-time training can preserve retrieval accuracy under aggressive compression. The code is released at https://www.github.com/THUNLP/latent-compaction

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且结果亮眼，但证据完整性仍不足
pros: 将KV缓存视作可优化潜变量并做测试时训练，方法角度有新意
在高压缩率下报告显著优于基线，且覆盖多个基准与模型族
cons: 摘要未充分交代训练开销、稳定性与失败案例，泛化与公平对比仍有不确定性

papers.title_zh: 潜在压实与测试时训练
papers.summary_zh: 长上下文会扩大键值（KV）缓存，增加生成过程中的内存使用和注意力成本。压缩这些缓存必须保留未见问题的信息。我们引入**潜在压缩**，它通过测试时训练学习紧凑的文档特定缓存。我们使用重建重要性、教师注意力和键空间多样性来初始化缓存条目。训练首先将注意力输出和对数归一化器与完整缓存的输出和对数归一化器相匹配，并且重建选择的条目保持固定。然后，它通过全缓存模型的端到端蒸馏来联合优化整个缓存。模型权重始终保持冻结，并且训练仅使用有关文档的通用提示，而无法访问下游问题或答案。 RULER、LongBench 和 Phonebook Lookup 上的实验表明，与预算匹配的压缩基准相比，取得了巨大的进步。例如，在 RULER 上，我们的方法在 32$\times$ 压缩下实现了 96.7% 的准确度，而 KVZip+ 的准确度为 40.0%。该方法还可以跨模型尺度和家族迁移，在 Qwen3 和 MiniCPM5 上都有检索增益。这些结果表明，将 KV 缓存视为神经网络并通过测试时训练对其进行优化可以在积极压缩下保持检索准确性。代码发布于https://www.github.com/THUNLP/latent-compaction

papers.title: ReaDy: Recurrent States as Dynamic Context for Speculative Drafting in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting multiple tokens per step, yet feature-based drafters rely on target hidden features whose contextual emphasis may not align with the needs of subsequent draft positions. Hybrid linear attention (HLA) models maintain compact recurrent states that accumulate historical associations, offering an efficient source of complementary context for speculative drafting. We introduce ReaDy, the first speculative decoding method, to the best of our knowledge, to leverage HLA recurrent states for position-specific context retrieval during drafting. ReaDy equips each draft position with a learned query to retrieve supplementary context directly from the target's committed recurrent states. A lightweight state reader integrates this context into draft representations through residual updates, while low-rank state reads and fused operators keep additional computation and I/O overhead low. Building on DSpark's parallel backbone and sequential prediction head, ReaDy employs a lightweight two-stage adaptation strategy, with reader capacity, state sources, and residual placement examined through ablation studies. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and dialogue, ReaDy achieves an average $3.16\times$ decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding with Qwen3.8-27B on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU. It outperforms DSpark on every benchmark, improving throughput by 7.97% and acceptance length by 8.50% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据完整性仍待加强。
pros: 首次将HLA递归状态用于位置特异的speculative drafting，方向有新意
在多任务基准上相对DSpark稳定增益，并强调低额外算力与I/O开销

papers.title_zh: ReaDy：循环状态作为混合线性注意力大语言模型中推测性起草的动态上下文
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过每步起草多个标记来加速自回归生成，但基于特征的起草者依赖于目标隐藏特征，其上下文重点可能与后续草案位置的需求不一致。混合线性注意力（HLA）模型保持紧凑的循环状态，积累历史关联，为推测性起草提供有效的补充上下文来源。据我们所知，我们引入了 ReaDy，这是第一个推测性解码方法，在绘图过程中利用 HLA 循环状态进行位置特定的上下文检索。 ReaDy 为每个草稿位置配备了学习查询，以直接从目标的已提交循环状态中检索补充上下文。轻量级状态读取器通过残差更新将此上下文集成到草稿表示中，而低秩状态读取和融合运算符可保持较低的额外计算和 I/O 开销。 ReaDy 基于 DSpark 的并行主干和顺序预测头，采用轻量级两阶段适应策略，通过消融研究检查读取器容量、状态源和残差位置。在涵盖数学、代码生成和对话的七个基准测试中，ReaDy 与在单个 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上使用 Qwen3.8-27B 进行自回归解码相比，平均实现了 3.16 美元\次$的解码加速。它在每个基准测试中都优于 DSpark，吞吐量平均提高了 7.97%，接受长度平均提高了 8.50%。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy 获取。

papers.title: FOLD: Position-Free Far Memory with Local Order for Long-Context Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM generation through lightweight drafting and parallel verification. It is particularly promising for long inputs, where KV-cache access costs can be amortized over multiple accepted tokens. Yet most drafters are trained on short sequences and degrade on long inputs, while long-context training is costly. Existing training-free approaches restrict the context window, rescale positions, or augment recent context with retrieved distant entries. Drafters, however, read target hidden states that already encode contextual and positional information, and their lightweight architecture makes full-history attention affordable. We propose FOLD, a training-free method that preserves exact local positions and treats all distant entries as far memory at a shared position. To counter attention dilution as the memory grows, we sharpen attention within it to emphasize relevant entries while separately controlling its total weight relative to the local window. Across six target-drafter pairs and diverse benchmarks of up to 256K tokens, FOLD predominantly delivers the highest speedup, with the best case more than doubling the speedup over autoregressive decoding, from 2.08$\times$ to 4.22$\times$.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但严谨性证据仍待补强。
pros: 提出训练免费的位置处理机制，兼顾局部顺序与远程记忆，契合长上下文推理痛点
实验覆盖六组target-drafter与最高256K上下文，报告了有竞争力且可观的加速收益
cons: 摘要未充分说明开销分解、统计显著性与失败案例，速度提升的稳健性和泛化边界仍不清晰

papers.title_zh: FOLD：具有本地顺序的无位置远记忆，用于长上下文推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过轻量级起草和并行验证加速 LLM 生成。它对于长输入特别有前途，其中 KV 缓存访问成本可以分摊到多个接受的令牌上。然而，大多数绘图员接受的是短序列培训，并在长输入上退化，而长上下文培训成本高昂。现有的免训练方法限制上下文窗口、重新调整位置或使用检索到的远程条目来增强最近的上下文。然而，起草者读取已经编码上下文和位置信息的目标隐藏状态，并且它们的轻量级架构使得全历史关注变得负担得起。我们提出了 FOLD，这是一种无需训练的方法，可以保留精确的本地位置，并将所有遥远的条目视为共享位置的远记忆。为了应对记忆增长时注意力的稀释，我们加强其中的注意力以强调相关条目，同时单独控制其相对于本地窗口的总权重。在六个目标起草者对和多达 256K 代币的不同基准中，FOLD 主要提供最高的加速比，最好的情况是自回归解码的加速比增加一倍以上，从 2.08$\times$ 到 4.22$\times$。

papers.title: TreeSpark: Learning to Draft the Trees You Verify for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Parallel drafters such as DFlash and DSpark reduce proposal latency, but early mismatches limit how much of each block can be accepted. Retaining alternatives introduces parent states and candidate choices that reference-conditioned training does not directly supervise. We introduce TreeSpark, a unified training and inference framework extending the semi-autoregressive DSpark architecture. It constructs parent-conditioned candidate trees from one backbone pass and replays their expansion, pruning, and budgeted packing during training. Survival negative log-likelihood weights retained edges by reference-derived path mass, while a capped coverage hinge promotes target-important alternatives near local selection boundaries. Both objectives reuse reference-chain target distributions without additional target forward passes. We evaluate greedy decoding with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on nine general benchmarks and six writing domains. Across targets and suites, TreeSpark improves mean acceptance length over DSpark by 23.4% to 31.6% and mean single-request throughput by 15.1% to 25.0%. Batched Qwen3-4B throughput improves by 12.6% to 17.2%. At fixed attention capacity and inference policy, the proposed supervision further improves mean acceptance length by approximately 6.4% and mean system throughput by 4.2% to 5.0% on Qwen3-4B.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且增益稳定，但实证边界仍需加强。
pros: 将树结构草稿训练与推理统一建模，针对保留分支监督缺口提出专门目标
在多模型与多基准上报告了较一致的接受长度与吞吐提升，具备系统实用价值
cons: 摘要未充分说明统计显著性、训练开销与消融细节，且评测主要集中在greedy设定，泛化到更广解码策略仍有风险

papers.title_zh: TreeSpark：学习起草您验证的推测解码树
papers.summary_zh: DFlash 和 DSpark 等并行起草器减少了提案延迟，但早期的不匹配限制了每个块可以接受的数量。保留替代方案引入了参考条件训练不直接监督的父状态和候选选择。我们引入了 TreeSpark，这是一个扩展半自回归 DSpark 架构的统一训练和推理框架。它从一个骨干通道构建父条件候选树，并在训练期间重播它们的扩展、修剪和预算打包。生存负对数似然通过参考导出的路径质量对保留的边缘进行权重，而有上限的覆盖铰链则促进局部选择边界附近的目标重要替代方案。两个目标都重用参考链目标分布，无需额外的目标前向传递。我们在九个通用基准和六个写入域上使用 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 评估贪婪解码。在目标和套件中，TreeSpark 的平均接受长度比 DSpark 提高了 23.4% 到 31.6%，平均单请求吞吐量提高了 15.1% 到 25.0%。批量 Qwen3-4B 吞吐量提高了 12.6% 至 17.2%。在固定注意力容量和推理​​策略下，所提出的监督进一步将 Qwen3-4B 上的平均接受长度提高了约 6.4%，将平均系统吞吐量提高了 4.2% 至 5.0%。

papers.title: Why Generate a Click? Plug-in Decision Heads for Web Agents
papers.summary: Web agents built on vision language models decide every action by generating text such as click(12), although most of that text encodes a choice among a few action types and a few dozen marked elements. We read these choices directly from the hidden states that the generator computes while it reads the goal and the screenshot. Plug-in decision heads on a frozen generator predict the action type, pool the visual tokens inside each numbered box to pick the target, and point at a listed text option or at a WRITE slot that leaves the writing of new text to the generator. A confidence cascade executes the heads' action when they are sure and otherwise lets the generator decode from the KV cache of the same forward pass. With Qwen3-VL 4B and 8B generators trained on 213k web steps, a strict threshold keeps the cascade between 0.3 points below and 1.4 points above the generator on seven offline test sets while the heads decide 12 to 64% of the steps. A looser threshold raises step success on unseen Mind2Web websites by 3.1 and 1.8 points, costs up to 2 points on GUIAct and MiniWoB++, and lifts WebArena task success from 12.5 to 13.8% (4B) and from 13.6 to 14.6% (8B) with less than half of the generated tokens. Training the heads jointly with the generator lowers the generator's own step success by up to 4.9 points; heads on a frozen generator avoid this cost.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路实用且增效明显，但稳健性证据仍偏弱。
pros: 提出冻结生成器上的插拔式决策头与置信级联，兼顾精度与解码开销
覆盖离线与在线多基准并报告token节省，工程价值和可部署性较强
cons: 性能提升幅度整体有限且存在数据集回退，阈值敏感性、统计显著性与长程任务稳定性证据不足

papers.title_zh: 为什么要产生点击？ Web 代理的插件决策头
papers.summary_zh: 基于视觉语言模型构建的网络代理通过生成文本（例如单击（12））来决定每个操作，尽管大多数文本编码了几种操作类型和几十个标记元素之间的选择。我们直接从生成器在读取目标和屏幕截图时计算的隐藏状态中读取这些选择。冻结生成器上的插件决策头预测动作类型，将每个编号框中的视觉标记集中起来以选择目标，并指向列出的文本选项或将新文本的写入留给生成器的写入槽。当确定时，置信级联执行头的动作，否则让生成器从同一前向传递的 KV 缓存中进行解码。使用在 213k Web 步骤上训练的 Qwen3-VL 4B 和 8B 生成器，严格的阈值使级联在七个离线测试集上保持在生成器下方 0.3 点和上方 1.4 点之间，而头部决定 12% 到 64% 的步骤。较宽松的阈值可将未见过的 Mind2Web 网站上的步骤成功率提高 3.1 和 1.8 点，在 GUIAct 和 MiniWoB++ 上最多花费 2 点，并将 WebArena 任务成功率从 12.5% 提高到 13.8% (4B) 和从 13.6% 提高到 14.6% (8B)，而生成的令牌不到一半。与生成器联合训练头部可将生成器自身的步数降低最多 4.9 点；冷冻发电机上的头部可以避免这种成本。

papers.title: MemDuet: Learning Dual-Process Memory for Long-Context Reasoning
papers.summary: Reasoning over infinitely long documents is becoming a reality with recurrent memory agents. However, increasing context length exacerbates the trade-off between reasoning performance and inference efficiency. Inspired by Kahneman's account of fast and slow thinking, we propose MemDuet, a dual-process memory framework that learns to coordinate a small language model for fast, parallel evidence selection from raw context chunks (System 1) with a large language model for memory-update verification and memory updates in document order (System 2). We train MemDuet in three stages: supervised fine-tuning of System 1 for evidence selection, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) of System 2 for verification and memory rewriting, and joint optimization of both policies to coordinate selection and updating for long-context reasoning. Experiments on diverse long-context reasoning benchmarks (RULER-HQA, LongBench v2, and 2WikiMultiHopQA) demonstrate a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off as context length grows. Averaged across evaluation settings on the three datasets, MemDuet achieves an end-to-end inference speedup of 9.74x and an output-token reduction of 73.91% relative to RL-MemAgent.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路有新意且实用，但证据充分性待加强。
pros: 将双过程认知映射到记忆代理，框架设计直观且有区分度
同时报告速度与token开销改进，契合serving效率核心诉求
cons: 摘要未给出关键消融与统计显著性，难判断各训练阶段真实贡献
主要对比集中于RL-MemAgent，跨方法与跨成本口径公平性仍存风险

papers.title_zh: MemDuet：学习双进程内存以进行长上下文推理
papers.summary_zh: 通过循环记忆代理，对无限长文档进行推理正在成为现实。然而，增加上下文长度会加剧推理性能和推理效率之间的权衡。受到 Kahneman 对快慢思维的启发，我们提出了 MemDuet，这是一个双进程内存框架，它学习协调一个小型语言模型，用于从原始上下文块中快速、并行选择证据（系统 1），与一个大型语言模型，用于内存更新验证和按文档顺序进行内存更新（系统 2）。我们分三个阶段训练 MemDuet：系统 1 的监督微调用于证据选择，系统 2 的组相对策略优化（GRPO）用于验证和内存重写，以及两个策略的联合优化以协调长上下文推理的选择和更新。对各种长上下文推理基准（RULER-HQA、LongBench v2 和 2WikiMultiHopQA）的实验表明，随着上下文长度的增长，可以实现有利的准确性与效率权衡。对三个数据集的评估设置进行平均，相对于 RL-MemAgent，MemDuet 的端到端推理速度提高了 9.74 倍，输出令牌减少了 73.91%。

papers.title: Energy Consumption Analysis of Discrete Diffusion and Autoregressive Language Models
papers.summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to scale, their energy consumption during inference has become a critical concern. While Autoregressive (AR) models are the industry standard, Diffusion Language Models (DLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative capable of parallel token generation. In this paper, we perform a comparative energy benchmark of diffusion models (LLaDA-8B, Dream-7B) against AR counterparts (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B). We analyze the trade-offs between model architecture, KV-cache optimization, and Joules-per-token efficiency. Our results show that at longer sequences (200--600 tokens), diffusion models achieve 2.5--2.7 J/token, approximately 2$\times$ more efficient than AR models with KV-cache (5.3--5.7 J/token). KV-cache provides substantial benefits for AR models at longer sequences (50--70\% energy reduction).
papers.journal_ref: GreenSys '26: Proceedings of the 2nd International Workshop on Systems and Methods for Sustainable Large-Scale AI, 2026, pp. 7-12

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 选题重要但证据链偏弱，结论可信度有限
pros: 聚焦推理能耗这一高现实价值问题，比较对象具代表性
给出J/token量化结果并讨论KV-cache作用，信息较可操作
cons: 仅摘要看缺少硬件配置、测量协议与统计显著性，严谨性不足
模型与解码/采样设置可能不等价，2×效率结论存在公平性风险

papers.title_zh: 离散扩散和自回归语言模型的能耗分析
papers.summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 的不断扩展，推理过程中的能耗已成为一个关键问题。虽然自回归 (AR) 模型是行业标准，但扩散语言模型 (DLLM) 已成为能够并行令牌生成的有前途的替代方案。在本文中，我们对扩散模型（LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B）与 AR 模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B）进行了能量基准比较。我们分析了模型架构、KV 缓存优化和每个令牌焦耳效率之间的权衡。我们的结果表明，在较长的序列（200--600 个令牌）下，扩散模型可实现 2.5--2.7 J/令牌，比带有 KV 缓存的 AR 模型（5.3--5.7 J/令牌）效率大约高 2 倍\倍。 KV 缓存为较长序列的 AR 模型提供了巨大的好处（节能 50--70%）。

papers.title: The Cost of Context: Profiling the Energy Footprint of Input Tokens in Large Language Models
papers.summary: The rapid adoption of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and long-context LLMs has shifted the computational burden toward the prefill phase---the initial stage where the model processes all input tokens in parallel before generating a response---yet its energy impact remains poorly characterised. We investigate the contradiction between massive hardware-level power spikes and the sub-linear marginal cost of input tokens reported in system-level studies. Through high-resolution telemetry of Llama-3.1 and Qwen-2 models on NVIDIA A100 hardware, we identify the efficiency threshold where $O(n^2)$ attention complexity overcomes GPU parallelisation. Our results quantify how optimised memory orchestration (PagedAttention) delays this scaling bottleneck across three orders of context scaling, yielding up to an 8.9$\times$ energy efficiency advantage at 112,000 tokens compared to standard baselines. Furthermore, we characterise the energy disparity between input and output tokens, demonstrating that optimised serving (vLLM) causes this ratio to narrow (from $\approx$850$\times$ to 750$\times$) as context scales due to high decode efficiency, whereas unoptimised baselines show a much smaller, roughly constant gap ($\approx$150--230$\times$) because their prefill is itself expensive. This work establishes context-scaling laws that differentiate engine-level optimisations from inherent model constraints, providing an empirical framework for sustainable LLM deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted at HotCarbon'26, the 5th Workshop on Sustainable Computer Systems; to appear in ACM SIGENERGY Energy Informatics Review, Vol. 6, Issue 2

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 选题重要且数据扎实，但方法外推仍有限。
pros: 聚焦RAG与长上下文下预填充能耗，问题定义清晰且现实价值高
提供跨模型高分辨率遥测与引擎对比，量化阈值与效率收益有说服力
cons: 仅凭摘要看，实验覆盖硬件与负载场景仍偏窄，统计稳健性与可复现细节（测量误差、置信区间、控制变量）尚不充分

papers.title_zh: 上下文成本：分析大型语言模型中输入令牌的能量足迹
papers.summary_zh: 检索增强生成 (RAG) 和长上下文法学硕士的快速采用已将计算负担转移到预填充阶段（模型在生成响应之前并行处理所有输入标记的初始阶段），但其能源影响仍然没有得到很好的描述。我们研究了系统级研究中报告的大规模硬件级功率峰值与输入代币的次线性边际成本之间的矛盾。通过 NVIDIA A100 硬件上的 Llama-3.1 和 Qwen-2 模型的高分辨率遥测，我们确定了 $O(n^2)$ 注意力复杂度克服 GPU 并行化的效率阈值。我们的结果量化了优化的内存编排 (PagedAttention) 如何在上下文扩展的三个数量级上延迟此扩展瓶颈，与标准基线相比，在 112,000 个令牌时产生高达 8.9$\times$ 的能源效率优势。此外，我们描述了输入和输出令牌之间的能量差异，证明优化服务（vLLM）导致该比率随着上下文缩放而缩小（从 $\approx$850$\times$ 到 750$\times$），而未优化的基线显示出更小的、大致恒定的差距（$\approx$150--230$\times$），因为它们的预填充本身就很昂贵。这项工作建立了上下文扩展法则，将引擎级优化与固有模型约束区分开来，为可持续的法学硕士部署提供了一个经验框架。

papers.title: Delta Tokenizer: Reference-Identical Tokenization of Session Deltas and Segment-Parallelism for Long Prompts on Multicore CPUs
papers.summary: An agent that drives an LLM sends the model the same conversation again and again, and each turn adds only a little text at the end. Inference engines reuse the KV cache of the shared prefix, so only the new tokens pass through the model. However, tokenization has no such shortcut. The CPU front end of the serving engine converts every request back into token IDs from its first character, which lengthens the time to first token (TTFT) and consumes CPU on every turn. We present Delta Tokenizer, a CPU tokenization front end that tokenizes only the delta between a request and the previous request of the same session. It retains the earlier token sequence, encodes again only the appended text and the short tail whose tokens the append could affect, and joins the two only at a position the tokenizer's splitting rules themselves cannot move, which keeps the result exact. For long requests with no state to reuse, it cuts the text where practical tokenizers already keep neighboring pieces independent, encodes the pieces on several cores at once, and concatenates the outputs into the reference encoding, exactly. A shared CPU pool schedules these chunks together with the short incremental updates, so an update runs between two chunks rather than behind an entire long job. The incremental path shortens the tokenization of a session turn by roughly 40x relative to the Hugging Face reference tokenizer, and on 16 cores the chunk-parallel path encodes a four-million-character request 8.2x faster than a serial encode and 1.6-2.1x faster than LoPT. Inside SGLang, Delta Tokenizer reduces the median TTFT through the chat interface by 59% at 100K tokens and brings the P99 TTFT of agent sessions down 9.5x under load and 23x when long requests tie up the front end. Every output we checked matches the reference, among them 41.8 billion documents encoded by its fast encoder.
papers.comment: 42 pages (16-page main text, references, and supplementary material), 14 figures, 35 tables. The incremental tokenization path and the fast encoder are open source in toktier at https://github.com/asu-idi/toktier. The chunk-parallel path, the CPU pool scheduler, and the SGLang adapter will be released in the same repository

papers.title_zh: Delta Tokenizer：会话增量的参考相同标记化和多核 CPU 上长提示的段并行性
papers.summary_zh: 驱动法学硕士的代理一次又一次地向模型发送相同的对话，并且每次都在末尾添加一点文本。推理引擎重用共享前缀的 KV 缓存，因此只有新令牌才能通过模型​​。然而，标记化没有这样的捷径。服务引擎的 CPU 前端将每个请求从第一个字符开始转换回令牌 ID，这会延长第一个令牌的时间 (TTFT)，并且每次都会消耗 CPU。我们提出了 Delta Tokenizer，这是一个 CPU 标记化前端，它仅标记同一会话的请求与前一个请求之间的增量。它保留较早的标记序列，仅再次编码附加文本和附加可能影响其标记的短尾，并仅在标记生成器的分割规则本身无法移动的位置连接两者，从而保持结果准确。对于没有状态可重用的长请求，它会在实际分词器已经保持相邻片段独立的情况下剪切文本，同时在多个核心上对片段进行编码，并将输出准确地连接到参考编码中。共享 CPU 池将这些块与短增量更新一起调度，因此更新在两个块之间运行，而不是在整个长作业之后运行。相对于 Hugging Face 参考分词器，增量路径将会话的分词周期缩短了大约 40 倍，并且在 16 个核心上，块并行路径对 400 万个字符的请求进行编码，速度比串行编码快 8.2 倍，比 LoPT 快 1.6-2.1 倍。在 SGLang 内部，Delta Tokenizer 在 100K 令牌时通过聊天界面的 TTFT 中值降低了 59%，并且在负载下使代理会话的 P99 TTFT 降低了 9.5 倍，在长请求占用前端时降低了 23 倍。我们检查的每个输出都与参考相符，其中包括由其快速编码器编码的 418 亿个文档。

papers.title: JetSpec++: Foresight Parallel Drafting with Self Refinements
papers.summary: Speculative decoding's effectiveness is governed by two quantities: the acceptance rate of drafted tokens and the cost of producing them. We show the two objectives can be co-optimized with algorithm-system co-design, and present JetSpec++, which retains a strong learned draft model while hiding its cost almost entirely. JetSpec++ combines three components: intra-block self refinement, which trains the draft model to iteratively correct its own parallel predictions within a block of tokens; inter-block foresight drafting, which begins the next block before the current one is verified; and pipelined drafting and verification, which overlaps the two stages so drafting's marginal wall-clock cost approaches zero. In comparison with state-of-the-art speculative decoding methods, JetSpec++ attains a wall-clock speedup of up to $7.45\times$ over autoregressive (AR) decoding and $1.54\times$ over DSpark, with up to 1,361 tokens per second for a single request on GB200, and an average acceptance length of 8.94 across seven benchmarks, while preserving the target model's output distribution. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/JetSpec.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables. Zhaoxiang Feng and Lanxiang Hu contributed equally. Code and models: https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/JetSpec

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 系统算法协同亮眼，但证据完整性待加强。
pros: 提出自修正+前瞻起草+流水并行的协同设计，思路完整且有新意
报告了较强端到端加速与较长接受长度，并强调保持目标分布一致

papers.title_zh: JetSpec++：具有自我完善的前瞻性并行绘图
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码的有效性由两个量决定：起草令牌的接受率和生产它们的成本。我们展示了这两个目标可以通过算法系统协同设计进行协同优化，并提出了 JetSpec++，它保留了强大的学习草稿模型，同时几乎完全隐藏了其成本。 JetSpec++ 结合了三个组件： 块内自我细化，训练草案模型以迭代地纠正其在令牌块内的并行预测；区块间预见起草，在当前区块验证之前开始下一个区块；流水线起草和验证，这两个阶段重叠，因此起草的边际挂钟成本接近于零。与最先进的推测解码方法相比，JetSpec++ 的挂钟加速比自回归 (AR) 解码高达 $7.45\times$，比 DSpark 高达 $1.54\times$，GB200 上的单个请求每秒高达 1,361 个令牌，七个基准测试的平均接受长度为 8.94，同时保留目标模型的输出分布。我们的代码和模型可在 https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/JetSpec 获取。

papers.title: PN-Mix: Pair-Norm Guided Mixed-Precision Key Cache Quantization for Efficient Long-Output LLM Inference
papers.summary: Long-output inference in large language models suffers from severe KV cache memory and bandwidth bottlenecks. While KV cache quantization alleviates this issue, low-bit quantization (e.g., 2-bit) severely degrades model accuracy. Recent mixed-precision key-cache quantization methods mitigate this degradation by allocating higher precision to important key channels, but estimate channel saliency using only key statistics. Through attention logit perturbation analysis at the RoPE channel-pair level, we show that quantization errors in channel pairs with large query--key pair-norm products contribute significantly to logit variation. Based on this insight, we propose PN-Mix, a mixed-precision key-cache quantization method for RoPE-based decoder-only LLMs, which allocates higher precision to salient channel pairs identified once during the prefill stage and reused throughout decoding. Across standard reasoning, code-generation, and AIME benchmarks, PN-Mix with 2.26-bit average precision achieves comparable or better average accuracy than prior mixed-precision methods using 2.32--2.39 bits. Furthermore, in our Pareto sweep, PN-Mix degrades gracefully down to 1.5 bits, whereas the compared baselines exhibit sharper performance drops below 2.25 bits.

quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法实用但创新与验证深度仍有限。
pros: 从RoPE通道对扰动分析出发，提出query-key联合显著性指标，动机较充分

papers.title_zh: PN-Mix：Pair-Norm 引导的混合精度密钥缓存量化，用于高效的长输出 LLM 推理
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型中的长输出推理受到严重的 KV 缓存和带宽瓶颈的影响。虽然 KV 缓存量化可以缓解这个问题，但低位量化（例如 2 位）会严重降低模型精度。最近的混合精度密钥缓存量化方法通过为重要的关键通道分配更高的精度来减轻这种退化，但仅使用关键统计数据来估计通道显着性。通过 RoPE 通道对级别的注意力 Logit 扰动分析，我们表明，具有大查询-密钥对范数乘积的通道对中的量化误差对 Logit 变化有显着贡献。基于这一见解，我们提出了 PN-Mix，这是一种用于基于 RoPE 的纯解码器 LLM 的混合精度密钥缓存量化方法，它为在预填充阶段识别一次并在整个解码过程中重复使用的显着通道对分配了更高的精度。在标准推理、代码生成和 AIME 基准测试中，具有 2.26 位平均精度的 PN-Mix 与之前使用 2.32--2.39 位的混合精度方法相比，实现了相当或更好的平均精度。此外，在我们的 Pareto 扫描中，PN-Mix 优雅地降级至 1.5 位，而比较的基线表现出更急剧的性能下降至 2.25 位以下。

papers.title: Scaling LLM Inference via Parallelism: Throughput-Latency Trade-off
papers.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) serving systems must balance latency and throughput while efficiently utilizing distributed GPU resources. This challenge arises because inference consists of two fundamentally different phases: prefill, which determines time-to-first-token (TTFT), and decode, which determines inter-token latency (ITL). The use of tensor parallelism (TP), pipeline parallelism (PP), and hybrid configurations exposes different trade-offs between these latency dimensions, making the optimal parallelism configuration highly dependent on workload characteristics, latency requirements, and context length. Moreover, despite the widespread adoption of distributed inference, there is still limited understanding of how parallelism configurations should be selected under varying workload conditions and service-level objectives (SLO). In this paper, we develop a systematic framework for characterizing LLM inference parallelism via throughput-latency trade-offs, SLO-aware serving, and long-context scalability. We introduce the notion of parallelism operating regions by constructing TTFT-ITL feasible sets and Pareto frontiers across different workload compositions, thereby revealing a systematic transition from TP-dominant to PP-dominant configurations as workloads become increasingly prefill-heavy. We further formulate SLO-aware parallelism selection using goodput, showing that stringent TTFT requirements favor PP-dominated configurations, whereas relaxed latency constraints progressively shift the optimality toward TP-dominated configurations with higher serving capacity. Finally, we demonstrate that increasing context length fundamentally changes the relative advantages of parallelism configurations, with PP-dominant configurations exhibiting more favorable scalability and SLO attainment in the long-context regime.

quality.verdict: 问题重要且框架完整，但方法创新有限

提出可行域与Pareto分析视角，并讨论长上下文下并行策略转移

papers.title_zh: 通过并行性扩展 LLM 推理：吞吐量-延迟权衡
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 服务系统必须平衡延迟和吞吐量，同时有效利用分布式 GPU 资源。出现这一挑战是因为推理由两个根本不同的阶段组成：预填充，它确定首次令牌时间 (TTFT)；解码，它确定令牌间延迟 (ITL)。张量并行性 (TP)、管道并行性 (PP) 和混合配置的使用暴露了这些延迟维度之间的不同权衡，使得最佳并行性配置高度依赖于工作负载特征、延迟要求和上下文长度。此外，尽管分布式推理得到了广泛采用，但对于如何在不同的工作负载条件和服务级别目标 (SLO) 下选择并行配置的理解仍然有限。在本文中，我们开发了一个系统框架，用于通过吞吐量延迟权衡、SLO 感知服务和长上下文可扩展性来表征 LLM 推理并行性。我们通过跨不同工作负载构成构建 TTFT-ITL 可行集和 Pareto 前沿来引入并行操作区域的概念，从而揭示随着工作负载变得越来越预填充，从 TP 主导配置到 PP 主导配置的系统转变。我们进一步使用良好吞吐量制定了 SLO 感知并行性选择，表明严格的 TTFT 要求有利于 PP 主导的配置，而宽松的延迟约束逐渐将最优性转向具有更高服务容量的 TP 主导配置。最后，我们证明增加上下文长度从根本上改变了并行配置的相对优势，PP 主导配置在长上下文机制中表现出更有利的可扩展性和 SLO 实现。

papers.title: Titan-Llama: Retrofitting Pre-trained LLMs with External Neural Memory Modules
papers.summary: Transformers are efficient to pre-train at scale because attention permits parallel computation across sequence positions, but long-context inference requires increasingly large KV caches. Efficient recurrent alternatives reduce the asymptotic complexity of inference, but their sequential dependence limits token-wise parallelism during training, making them harder to scale. Further, the current paradigm of extending long context tasks creates competing notions of retaining information precisely and keeping long-context inference efficient. To address this gap, we introduce Titan-Llama, a post-training method for retrofitting attention-based language models with a hierarchical memory architecture that updates parameters at test-time. Titan-Llama applies a blockwise attention mask and preserves full-fidelity attention over recent tokens while compressing historical context into recurrent, fixed-size neural memory modules (NMMs). Our formulation allows pre-trained attention layers to be replaced without training a new language model from scratch. On Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, Titan-Llama raises accuracy over segmented attention windows from 23.87\% to 40.51\% on QuALITY and from 14.50\% to 40.75\% on LongHealth. Inference benchmarks show more than 20\% faster prefill, 37\% faster decode at medium context lengths, and 24\% lower steady-state decode memory usage in the evaluated configurations. Together, these results demonstrate that incorporating memory architecture mechanisms that utilize test-time training effectively modulates long-context behavior of pre-trained models, offering a practical route to adapting pre-trained transformers for efficient long-context inference. Our code is released on Github \href{https://github.com/sarahpannn/titans-pytorch/tree/main}{GitHub}

papers.title_zh: Titan-Llama：使用外部神经记忆模块改造预训练的法学硕士
papers.summary_zh: Transformer 可以有效地进行大规模预训练，因为注意力允许跨序列位置进行并行计算，但长上下文推理需要越来越大的 KV 缓存。高效的循环替代方案降低了推理的渐近复杂性，但它们的顺序依赖性限制了训练期间的标记并行性，使它们更难扩展。此外，当前扩展长上下文任务的范式创建了精确保留信息和保持长上下文推理高效的竞争概念。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了 Titan-Llama，这是一种训练后方法，用于通过在测试时更新参数的分层内存架构来改造基于注意力的语言模型。 Titan-Llama 应用块式注意力掩码并保留对最近标记的全保真注意力，同时将历史上下文压缩到循环、固定大小的神经记忆模块 (NMM) 中。我们的公式允许替换预先训练的注意力层，而无需从头开始训练新的语言模型。在 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 上，Titan-Llama 将分段注意力窗口的 QuALITY 准确率从 23.87\% 提高到 40.51\%，将 LongHealth 从 14.50\% 提高到 40.75\%。推理基准测试显示，在评估的配置中，预填充速度提高了 20% 以上，中等上下文长度的解码速度提高了 37%，稳态解码内存使用率降低了 24%。总之，这些结果表明，结合利用测试时训练的内存架构机制可以有效地调节预训练模型的长上下文行为，为调整预训练变压器以实现高效的长上下文推理提供了实用的途径。我们的代码发布在 Github \href{https://github.com/sarahpannn/titans-pytorch/tree/main}{GitHub}

papers.title: Joint Subspace Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
papers.summary: Sparse attention reduces the KV-cache traffic that dominates long-context LLM decoding, but practical methods largely operate at coarse granularity. Token-level selection offers finer control, yet presents two challenges: low-dimensional scoring may lose query--key structure needed for accurate ranking, while gathering scattered selected tokens can offset the resulting latency benefit. We introduce Joint Subspace Sparse Attention (JSSA) to address both challenges. For selection quality, JSSA learns a shared low-dimensional query--key subspace by minimizing token-score preservation error. We upper-bound the resulting non-convex objective with a tractable marginal objective that admits a closed-form spectral solution; direct refinement of the exact objective provides no measurable improvement in the tested settings. For execution efficiency, we develop a gather-free token-level indexed-attention kernel that supports distinct per-KV-head selections under the standard grouped-query attention (GQA) KV-cache layout. Across standard GQA, hybrid sliding-window/global attention, and Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) models, JSSA consistently remains close to full-KV accuracy while avoiding the substantial generation-length inflation and architecture-dependent failures observed with competing methods. On an NVIDIA B200 GPU, JSSA achieves up to $6.43\times$ the decoding throughput of full-KV attention at 128K context. JSSA achieves reasoning accuracy comparable to model-native DSA without model training and reaches 96--99\% of its decoding throughput even at 700B scale large models.

cons: 摘要中速度与泛化结论较强，缺少误差边界、消融细节与独立复现实证支撑

papers.title_zh: 用于高效长上下文解码的联合子空间稀疏注意力
papers.summary_zh: 稀疏注意力减少了在长上下文 LLM 解码中占主导地位的 KV 缓存流量，但实际方法主要在粗粒度上运行。令牌级别选择提供了更精细的控制，但提出了两个挑战：低维评分可能会丢失查询——准确排名所需的关键结构，而收集分散的选定令牌可以抵消由此产生的延迟优势。我们引入联合子空间稀疏注意力（JSSA）来应对这两个挑战。为了保证选择质量，JSSA 通过最小化标记分数保存误差来学习共享的低维查询——键子空间。我们用一个易于处理的边际目标来限制最终的非凸目标，该边际目标允许封闭形式的谱解；对确切目标的直接细化不会对测试设置提供可测量的改进。为了提高执行效率，我们开发了一个无收集令牌级索引注意内核，该内核支持标准分组查询注意（GQA）KV 缓存布局下不同的每 KV 头选择。在标准 GQA、混合滑动窗口/全局注意力和多头潜在注意力 (MLA) 模型中，JSSA 始终保持接近全 KV 精度，同时避免了在竞争方法中观察到的大量生成长度膨胀和架构相关的故障。在 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上，JSSA 在 128K 上下文中实现了高达 $6.43\times$ 的全 KV 注意力的解码吞吐量。 JSSA 在没有模型训练的情况下实现了与模型原生 DSA 相当的推理精度，即使在 700B 规模的大型模型上也能达到其解码吞吐量的 96--99%。

papers.title: SP$^2$ec: Adaptive Self-Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
papers.summary: Speculative Decoding (SD) has demonstrated its efficacy in accelerating large language model inference, but for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the diverse input modalities make it difficult for a small trained drafter to achieve consistently high throughput. Self-speculative decoding reuses parts of the target model as a drafter which retains the multi-modal capability of the VLMs, yet its efficiency depends on choosing a suitable draft configuration for each prompt. We propose Single-Peak SPeculative decoding (SP$^2$ec), a training-free bandit algorithm that adapts the draft configuration during generation. SP$^2$ec exploits the single-peak throughput pattern observed in existing self-speculative methods, including SWIFT, KnapSpec, SpecVLM, and our simple cosSim. Our algorithmic design explicitly minimizes a novel notion of wall-time regret for each given query, corresponding to the empirical wall-time latency. Theoretical guarantees on the wall-time regret show that SP$^2$ec can exploit the optimal draft configuration, with negligible exploration cost. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B across visual and textual tasks show consistent improvements of up to 11\% over the original self-speculative methods, demonstrating the wide applicability of the proposed SP$^2$ec algorithm.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中要害，方法实用但理论外推仍有限。
pros: 面向VLM自推测解码的自适应配置选择，定位准确且具实用价值
提出免训练bandit并显式优化墙钟时延遗憾，实验跨模型与任务有稳定增益
cons: 单峰假设与“可忽略探索开销”对不同硬件/负载场景的稳健性仍需更强证据

papers.title_zh: SP$^2$ec：视觉语言模型的自适应自推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 推测解码 (SD) 已证明其在加速大型语言模型推理方面的功效，但对于视觉语言模型 (VLM) 来说，多样化的输入模式使得经过培训的小型绘图员很难实现持续的高吞吐量。自推测解码重用目标模型的一部分作为绘图器，保留了 VLM 的多模态功能，但其效率取决于为每个提示选择合适的绘图配置。我们提出了单峰 SPeculative 解码（SP$^2$ec），这是一种无需训练的老虎机算法，可在生成过程中适应草稿配置。 SP$^2$ec 利用现有自我推测方法中观察到的单峰值吞吐量模式，包括 SWIFT、KnapSpec、SpecVLM 和我们的简单 cosSim。我们的算法设计明确地最小化了每个给定查询的挂机时间遗憾的新概念，对应于经验挂机时间延迟。对墙时间遗憾的理论保证表明，SP$^2$ec 可以利用最佳吃水配置，而勘探成本可以忽略不计。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 和 LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B 上跨视觉和文本任务的广泛实验表明，与原始自我推测方法相比，一致性改进高达 11%，证明了所提出的 SP$^2$ec 算法的广泛适用性。

papers.title: Kwai Summary Attention V2 Technical Report
papers.summary: Summary-token architectures such as Kwai Summary Attention (KSA) compress distant context into learnable Summary token per chunk, and hybrid variants interleave these layers with full attention to retain exact access to the original text. In such hybrid KSA-Full architecture, the interleaving inserted summary tokens are served as a streaming flow role across different layers. Although effective, however, it also introduce some bottlenecks: (1) the different layers summary compression chunk must be same, therefore hard to reach a flexible KV Cache compression, e.g., different layer set different summary compression chunk window. (2) in the full-attention layers, the summary token introduced additional computation cost, but such layer ignore them and still pay quadratic prefilling, therefore unfriendly to the computation side. Motivated by them, we developed the KSA V2, which not only achieves a more flexible KV cache memory compression but also reduces the computation cost in Full attention layer. Specifically, we found that the summary tokens can serve two roles: the KV memory and sparse indexer.

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 方向有价值，但当前证据与表述不足
pros: 抓住混合摘要注意力在KV压缩与算力开销的关键瓶颈
提出摘要token双角色思路，潜在提升内存压缩灵活性与全注意力层效率
cons: 摘要缺少算法细节、复杂度分析和理论依据，难判断实质创新幅度
未给出实验设置与对比结果，无法验证收益、稳定性和泛化性

papers.title_zh: 快手摘要关注V2技术报告
papers.summary_zh: 摘要令牌架构（例如 Kwai 摘要注意（KSA））将遥远的上下文压缩为每个块的可学习摘要令牌，并且混合变体以充分的注意力交织这些层，以保留对原始文本的精确访问。在这种混合 KSA-Full 架构中，交错插入的摘要令牌充当跨不同层的流角色。虽然有效，但也引入了一些瓶颈：（1）不同层的摘要压缩块必须相同，因此很难达到灵活的KV Cache压缩，例如不同层设置不同的摘要压缩块窗口。 （2）在full-attention层中，summary token引入了额外的计算成本，但是该层忽略它们并且仍然进行二次预填充，因此对计算端不友好。受他们的激励，我们开发了 KSA V2，它不仅实现了更灵活的 KV 缓存压缩，而且降低了 Full Attention 层的计算成本。具体来说，我们发现摘要标记可以起到两个作用：KV 内存和稀疏索引器。

papers.title: MultiAlloc: Budget-Aware Precision Allocation for KV Cache Quantization
papers.summary: The Key-Value (KV) cache constitutes a dominant source of memory consumption during large language model (LLM) inference, particularly in long-context and complex reasoning scenarios. Existing KV cache quantization methods have explored different compression granularities, including layer-wise precision adjustment and token-level information preservation. In practical deployment, however, the key challenge is not merely compression, but how to allocate limited quantization resources among heterogeneous precision preservation strategies under a fixed KV cache memory budget. We propose MultiAlloc, a profiling-guided precision allocation framework for KV cache quantization that adaptively distributes limited quantization resources between layer-wise precision enhancement and token-wise preservation. MultiAlloc employs lightweight offline profiling to characterize layer sensitivity and token importance, enabling adaptive precision allocation under a fixed memory constraint. Guided by the profiled memory--accuracy trade-off, it automatically derives an effective precision allocation strategy without online allocation search, and applies the resulting policy during inference. Extensive experiments on reasoning and long-context benchmarks demonstrate that MultiAlloc consistently improves over layer-wise, token-wise, and recent multi-granularity KV cache quantization methods under matched memory budgets across diverse models, including Mistral, Llama, DeepSeek-Qwen, and QwQ.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中部署痛点，但创新幅度中等。
pros: 从固定预算约束出发统一层级与token级分配，设定实用且有工程价值
强调离线profiling与免在线搜索，推理时延与可部署性潜力较好
cons: 核心思想偏向策略整合与分配优化，算法新颖性可能不足以支撑顶会强创新门槛
摘要未体现统计显著性、开销拆解与失败案例，方法稳健性与泛化边界仍待验证

papers.title_zh: MultiAlloc：KV 缓存量化的预算感知精确分配
papers.summary_zh: 键值（KV）缓存是大语言模型（LLM）推理过程中内存消耗的主要来源，特别是在长上下文和复杂的推理场景中。现有的KV缓存量化方法探索了不同的压缩粒度，包括逐层精度调整和token级信息保存。然而，在实际部署中，关键的挑战不仅仅是压缩，而是如何在固定的KV缓存内存预算下，在异构精度保存策略之间分配有限的量化资源。我们提出了 MultiAlloc，一种用于 KV 缓存量化的分析引导精度分配框架，它在逐层精度增强和逐令牌保存之间自适应地分配有限的量化资源。 MultiAlloc 采用轻量级离线分析来表征层敏感性和令牌重要性，从而在固定内存约束下实现自适应精度分配。在分析内存与准确性权衡的指导下，它会自动导出有效的精度分配策略，而无需在线分配搜索，并在推理过程中应用生成的策略。关于推理和长上下文基准的大量实验表明，MultiAlloc 在不同模型（包括 Mistral、Llama、DeepSeek-Qwen 和 QwQ）的匹配内存预算下，持续改进了逐层、逐令牌和最新的多粒度 KV 缓存量化方法。

papers.title: RadixFlow: Filling Execution Bubbles in Prefix-Cached Hybrid LLM Serving
papers.summary: Prefix reuse improves LLM inference by sharing the KV cache of common prompt prefixes. This helps only if the scheduler can execute a matched branch in the current worker round. Schedulers assume that a matched prefix is ready, which holds for full attention but fails for hybrid LLMs. There, a branch (the consumer) may need recurrent state that another branch (the producer) is still computing in the same round. The native scheduler stops its waiting-queue scan at this blocked consumer, and the resulting head-of-line blocking creates \emph{execution bubbles}: idle batch slots that independent work could fill. We introduce RadixFlow, which decouples prefix matching from state readiness. Its state-ready traversal turns a global scan barrier into a local wait: only the consumer is blocked until the next round, while feasible independent branches keep filling the batch under the native state check. On five hybrid models, RadixFlow lowers mean latency by 3\% to 24\% and worker rounds by 11\% to 44\% at almost unchanged reuse. On the larger Qwen3.5 models, ablations show that most of the gain comes from traversal, which adds little on a full-attention control. Heavier rounds limit how much of this saving reaches latency.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，工程价值较高但理论深度一般
pros: 准确识别混合模型前缀复用中的执行气泡与队首阻塞瓶颈
方案改动聚焦调度遍历并在多模型上给出稳定延迟与轮次收益
cons: 从摘要看缺少更强理论分析与更广负载/系统设置下的泛化与边界验证

papers.title_zh: RadixFlow：在前缀缓存混合 LLM 服务中填充执行气泡
papers.summary_zh: 前缀重用通过共享常见提示前缀的 KV 缓存来改进 LLM 推理。仅当调度程序可以在当前工作轮中执行匹配的分支时，这才有帮助。调度程序假设匹配的前缀已准备就绪，这可以引起充分关注，但对于混合 LLM 来说则失败。在那里，一个分支（消费者）可能需要另一个分支（生产者）仍在同一轮中计算的循环状态。本机调度程序在这个被阻塞的消费者处停止其等待队列扫描，并且由此产生的队头阻塞会创建\emph{执行气泡}：独立工作可以填充的空闲批处理槽。我们引入 RadixFlow，它将前缀匹配与状态准备情况解耦。它的状态就绪遍历将全局扫描屏障转变为本地等待：只有消费者在下一轮之前被阻塞，而可行的独立分支在本机状态检查下继续填充批次。在五种混合模型上，RadixFlow 将平均延迟降低了 3% 到 24%，工作轮数降低了 11% 到 44%，而重用率几乎没有变化。在较大的 Qwen3.5 模型上，消融表明大部分增益来自遍历，这对全注意力控制几乎没有增加。较重的回合限制了这种节省达到延迟的程度。

papers.title: SparPR: Runtime KV-Cache Recovery for Resource-Constrained LLM Inference on Consumer Hardware
papers.summary: Running large language models (LLMs) on consumer hardware is bottlenecked by the key-value (KV) cache, which grows with every decoded token and quickly exhausts the memory and bandwidth of a single consumer GPU. We present SparPR (Sparse Partial Recomputation), a runtime KV-cache recovery mechanism that does not modify model weights and requires no offline training. SparPR couples three online decisions: Query-Aware key-block selection scores historical blocks against the current query; dynamic budget control estimates per-block copy and recompute costs to decide how many blocks to retain; and on-demand local recomputation with cost-aware fallback merges retained blocks into continuous spans and switches between sparse recomputation and full recovery according to a runtime cost comparison. Implemented on FlexGen/FlexLLMGen, SparPR is evaluated on a single consumer laptop (RTX 3070 Ti 8GB, Ryzen 9 6900HX, 16GB RAM). It cuts end-to-end latency by 31%, 52%, and 63% at 1k, 2k, and 4k prompt tokens respectively, with 1.4x-2.7x higher throughput, and completes an 8k-token workload in 44 minutes where the FlexGen baseline times out. Under a fixed cache budget, SparPR retains a Needle Accuracy that stays well above StreamingLLM and H2O at every keep ratio, and ablation studies confirm that the three mechanisms act jointly.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值突出，但证据广度仍不足
pros: 提出无需训练与改权重的在线KV恢复机制，面向消费级硬件痛点
在长上下文下报告了显著时延与吞吐提升，并给出消融与精度对比
cons: 评测平台与基线范围较窄，缺少跨模型/跨硬件泛化、统计显著性与最坏情况开销分析

papers.title_zh: SparPR：消费类硬件上资源受限的 LLM 推理的运行时 KV 缓存恢复
papers.summary_zh: 在消费类硬件上运行大型语言模型 (LLM) 会受到键值 (KV) 缓存的瓶颈，该缓存会随着每个解码的令牌而增长，并迅速耗尽单个消费类 GPU 的内存和带宽。我们提出了 SparPR（稀疏部分重计算），这是一种运行时 KV 缓存恢复机制，不会修改模型权重，也不需要离线训练。 SparPR 结合了三个在线决策： 查询感知关键块选择根据当前查询对历史块进行评分；动态预算控制估计每个块的复制并重新计算成本，以决定保留多少块；具有成本感知回退功能的按需本地重新计算将保留的块合并为连续的跨度，并根据运行时成本比较在稀疏重新计算和完全恢复之间切换。 SparPR 在 FlexGen/FlexLLMGen 上实施，并在单台消费笔记本电脑（RTX 3070 Ti 8GB、Ryzen 9 6900HX、16GB RAM）上进行评估。它在 1k、2k 和 4k 提示令牌时分别将端到端延迟减少了 31%、52% 和 63%，吞吐量提高了 1.4 倍至 2.7 倍，并在 FlexGen 基准超时的情况下在 44 分钟内完成 8k 令牌工作负载。在固定缓存预算下，SparPR 在每个保持率下都保持远高于 StreamingLLM 和 H2O 的针精度，并且消融研究证实这三种机制共同作用。

papers.title: H-DDCM: Hadamard Codebooks for Fast Generative Image and Video Compression
papers.summary: Training-free diffusion-based compression methods repurpose the generative priors of a diffusion or a flow model to compress data without retraining them as task-specific codecs. Recent codebook-based approaches such as Turbo-DDCM achieve strong perceptual quality at ultra-low bitrates, but their reliance on dense Gaussian codebooks remains costly in both memory and computation, and scales poorly with the large latent dimensions of modern image and video generators. Their combinatorial bitstream encoding further becomes computationally heavy at this scale. We introduce H-DDCM, a scalable generative compression framework that replaces Gaussian codebooks with implicit randomized Hadamard dictionaries. The fast Walsh-Hadamard transform allows for implicitly synthesizing full-dimensional dictionaries with $O(d \log d)$ compute for projection and reconstruction and $O(d)$ memory, without materializing the full-dimensional dictionary. We further introduce an efficient table-free lexicographic coding scheme that makes combinatorial encoding practical at larger dimensions. Beyond images, we adapt the framework to an autoregressive video flow model and develop a streaming compression scheme that periodically re-encodes recently reconstructed frames into a fresh KV-cache prefix, preserving temporal context across segments at no additional transmitted bits. This enables long-form, close to real-time generative video compression on a single GPU. Across image and video benchmarks, H-DDCM achieves competitive rate-distortion-perception performance while substantially reducing the memory and computational overhead of codebook-based training-free generative compression.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且工程价值高，但实证严谨性待验证。
pros: 以随机Hadamard字典替代高斯码本，显著改善内存与计算扩展性
提出无表字典序编码与视频流式重编码机制，面向长视频实时压缩场景
cons: 摘要未充分说明复杂度常数、消融与失败案例，跨数据集泛化和公平对比风险仍在

papers.title_zh: H-DDCM：用于快速生成图像和视频压缩的哈达玛码本
papers.summary_zh: 基于免训练扩散的压缩方法重新利用扩散或流模型的生成先验来压缩数据，而无需将它们重新训练为特定于任务的编解码器。最近基于码本的方法（例如 Turbo-DDCM）在超低比特率下实现了强大的感知质量，但它们对密集高斯码本的依赖在内存和计算方面仍然成本高昂，并且与现代图像和视频生成器的大潜在维度的扩展性很差。在这种规模下，它们的组合比特流编码的计算量进一步增大。我们引入了 H-DDCM，这是一种可扩展的生成压缩框架，它用隐式随机 Hadamard 字典取代高斯码本。快速 Walsh-Hadamard 变换允许使用用于投影和重建的 $O(d \log d)$ 计算以及 $O(d)$ 内存隐式合成全维字典，而无需具体化全维字典。我们进一步引入了一种高效的无表词典编码方案，使组合编码在更大的维度上变得实用。除了图像之外，我们还将该框架适应自回归视频流模型，并开发了一种流压缩方案，该方案定期将最近重建的帧重新编码为新的 KV 缓存前缀，从而在不额外传输比特的情况下保留跨片段的时间上下文。这使得在单个 GPU 上实现长格式、接近实时的生成视频压缩成为可能。在图像和视频基准测试中，H-DDCM 实现了具有竞争力的速率失真感知性能，同时大大减少了基于码本的免训练生成压缩的内存和计算开销。

papers.title: ChampionKV: Head-Wise Adaptive Budget Allocation for KV Cache Compression
papers.summary: Some observation-window-based KV cache compressors use prompt attention to identify important tokens but allocate uniform or predefined budgets across heads, overlooking input-dependent differences in budget demand. We propose ChampionKV, an input-adaptive head-wise budget allocator for long-context KV cache compression. It uses the maximum aggregated observation-window attention score as a lightweight empirical proxy for attention concentration, assigning larger budgets to heads with dispersed attention and smaller budgets to concentrated heads. An abnormal-head mask and a floor-budget mechanism improve robustness under weak attention responses. ChampionKV plugs into compressors such as SnapKV and PyramidKV without changing their token-selection procedures. On LongBench and RULER, both Champion variants consistently improve over their SnapKV and PyramidKV base compressors; the improvements are largest and statistically significant on Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, especially under tight budgets, whereas results on the tested 7B/8B models remain competitive but mixed. ChampionKV does not uniformly outperform Ada-KV, whose global cross-head Top-K selection retains an advantage in several settings. Controlled analysis further shows improved retained attention mass over the corresponding base compressors at negligible overhead.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路务实有效，但创新与统治性不足。
pros: 提出按输入自适应的分头预算分配，能无缝插入现有压缩器
在70B模型与紧预算场景收益明显，并报告统计显著性与低开销分析
cons: 方法偏增量改进，且对7B/8B结果不稳定，整体泛化与优势边界仍有限
未能稳定超过Ada-KV，说明在跨头全局选择范式下竞争力尚不足

papers.title_zh: ChampionKV：用于 KV 缓存压缩的 Head-Wise 自适应预算分配
papers.summary_zh: 一些基于观察窗口的 KV 缓存压缩器使用提示注意力来识别重要令牌，但在各个头之间分配统一或预定义的预算，忽略了预算需求中与输入相关的差异。我们提出了 ChampionKV，一种用于长上下文 KV 缓存压缩的输入自适应头预算分配器。它使用最大聚合观察窗口注意力分数作为注意力集中度的轻量级经验代理，为注意力分散的头部分配较大的预算，为注意力集中的头部分配较小的预算。异常头罩和底线预算机制提高了弱注意力响应下的鲁棒性。 ChampionKV 可插入 SnapKV 和 PyramidKV 等压缩器，而无需更改其令牌选择程序。在 LongBench 和 RULER 上，两种 Champion 变体都比其 SnapKV 和 PyramidKV 基础压缩器持续改进； Llama3.1-70B-Instruct 上的改进最大且具有统计显着性，特别是在预算紧张的情况下，而测试的 7B/8B 模型的结果仍然具有竞争力，但好坏参半。 ChampionKV 的表现并不完全优于 Ada-KV，后者的全局十字头 Top-K 选择在多种设置中保留了优势。受控分析进一步表明，在开销可以忽略不计的情况下，与相应的基础压缩器相比，保留注意力质量得到了改善。

papers.title: LatentRemedy: Efficient Remedy For Non-Prefix KV Cache Reuse in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.summary: Non-prefix KV cache reuse is a promising approach for improving inference efficiency in multi-agent systems as agents share the same context blocks. However, when agents have conflicting tasks, directly reusing non-prefix KV caches across agents can severely degrade model performance, causing up to a 90% drop. Existing remedies, including selective recomputation and offset-based calibration, recover a limited fraction of this loss. We argue that the problem lies not only in contaminated KV representations but also in the agent's difficulty interpreting reused context under its own instructions. To this end, we introduce LatentRemedy, which uses a few task-conditioned latent tokens to help the target agent leverage reused context without recomputing the shared block. Specifically, we use an MLP to map the last hidden state of the target prefix into a small number of latent tokens, which are placed after the reused KV block to interact with the shared context. To guide subsequent predictions toward the target task, we train the MLP through full-prefill distillation. Experiments show that LatentRemedy consistently outperforms existing reuse baselines on conflicting tasks while maintaining TTFT close to direct reuse as cache size grows. Code and data are available at https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/kvreuse.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法有新意但证据仍偏初步。
pros: 准确聚焦非前缀KV复用在多智能体冲突任务中的性能塌陷问题，应用价值明确

papers.title_zh: LatentRemedy：多代理系统中非前缀 KV 缓存重用的有效补救措施
papers.summary_zh: 由于代理共享相同的上下文块，无前缀 KV 缓存重用是提高多代理系统中推理效率的一种有前途的方法。然而，当智能体有冲突的任务时，跨智能体直接重用非前缀 KV 缓存可能会严重降低模型性能，导致高达 90% 的下降。现有的补救措施，包括选择性重新计算和基于偏移的校准，只能弥补这种损失的有限部分。我们认为，问题不仅在于受污染的 KV 表示，还在于智能体难以根据自己的指令解释重用的上下文。为此，我们引入了 LatentRemedy，它使用一些任务条件的潜在令牌来帮助目标代理利用重用的上下文，而无需重新计算共享块。具体来说，我们使用 MLP 将目标前缀的最后一个隐藏状态映射到少量潜在令牌中，这些潜在令牌被放置在重用的 KV 块之后以与共享上下文交互。为了指导后续对目标任务的预测，我们通过全预填充蒸馏来训练 MLP。实验表明，LatentRemedy 在冲突任务上始终优于现有的重用基线，同时随着缓存大小的增长，保持 TTFT 接近直接重用。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/kvreuse 获取。

papers.title: AlignPred: Error-Controlled KV Cache Compression via Alignment and Predictive Coding
papers.summary: Long-running agents retain KV caches across turns and sessions for hours or days. Compressing these persistent caches requires reducing storage while controlling reconstruction error. We present AlignPred, a codec that combines local alignment with predictive coding under a configurable KV reconstruction-error budget. Local orthogonal transforms align related heads or layers into a common coordinate frame, allowing AlignPred to combine token-wise prediction with same-token prediction across heads or layers. Residuals are quantized on an error-bounded lattice and entropy-coded, without learned predictors, encoder-side mode search, or large joint transforms. Across three attention mechanisms, AlignPred requires less storage than the evaluated baselines at comparable measured reconstruction error. Against the evaluated CPU codec implementations, it decodes at least 1.6 times faster while matching or improving encode time. AlignPred achieves near-native task scores at substantially compressed operating points on LongBench-Pro at 128K context. AlignPred's SGLang HiCache integration reduces persistent target-KV storage by 42-72% relative to native HiCache, with comparable latency.

papers.title_zh: AlignPred：通过对齐和预测编码进行错误控制的 KV 缓存压缩
papers.summary_zh: 长时间运行的代理会在轮次和会话之间保留 KV 缓存数小时或数天。压缩这些持久缓存需要减少存储空间，同时控制重建错误。我们推出了 AlignPred，一种在可配置的 KV 重建误差预算下将局部对齐与预测编码相结合的编解码器。局部正交变换将相关的头或层对齐到公共坐标系中，从而允许 AlignPred 将标记预测与跨头或层的相同标记预测结合起来。残差在误差有界点阵上进行量化并进行熵编码，无需学习预测器、编码器端模式搜索或大型联合变换。在三种注意力机制中，AlignPred 需要的存储空间少于在可比较的测量重建误差下评估的基线。与评估的 CPU 编解码器实现相比，它的解码速度至少提高了 1.6 倍，同时匹配或改进了编码时间。 AlignPred 在 128K 环境下的 LongBench-Pro 上以大幅压缩的操作点实现了接近原生的任务分数。相对于本机 HiCache，AlignPred 的 SGLang HiCache 集成将持久目标 KV 存储减少了 42-72%，且延迟时间相当。

papers.title: BELT : BEhavior-Aligned Low-Rank KV Cache Compression with Learned Top-k Rank Allocation
papers.summary: Long-context inference makes the key-value (KV) cache a major memory bottleneck for large language models. We propose BELT, a low-rank KV cache compression framework. Its key-side objective targets attention distributions rather than raw keys or pre-softmax logits, yielding a quadratic surrogate with a closed-form low-rank solution. A learned global rank allocator uses differentiable soft selection during training and hard selection at deployment to meet a user-specified component budget. Experiments demonstrate improved model quality under aggressive compression and increased decoding throughput at comparable accuracy. Evaluated across three LLMs and multiple benchmarks, BELT achieves up to 70% low-rank KV cache compression while outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 23.3 points on LongBench, and up to 17.8x overall KV cache reduction when combined with quantization. With Triton-based GPU kernels and a quantized cache, BELT delivers up to 2.7x speedup for the attention module and 3.3x end-to-end decoding throughput.

quality.label: 较高

papers.title_zh: BELT：具有学习的 Top-k Rank 分配的行为对齐低阶 KV 缓存压缩
papers.summary_zh: 长上下文推理使键值 (KV) 缓存成为大型语言模型的主要内存瓶颈。我们提出了 BELT，一种低阶 KV 缓存压缩框架。它的关键侧目标针对的是注意力分布，而不是原始关键点或 pre-softmax logits，产生具有封闭形式低秩解决方案的二次代理。学习的全局排名分配器在训练期间使用可微的软选择，在部署时使用硬选择，以满足用户指定的组件预算。实验表明，在积极压缩的情况下模型质量得到了提高，并且解码吞吐量在相当的精度下得到了提高。经过三个 LLM 和多个基准测试的评估，BELT 实现了高达 70% 的低阶 KV 缓存压缩，同时在 LongBench 上比最强基准高出高达 23.3 分，与量化相结合时，整体 KV 缓存减少量高达 17.8 倍。凭借基于 Triton 的 GPU 内核和量化缓存，BELT 为注意力模块提供高达 2.7 倍的加速，并提供 3.3 倍的端到端解码吞吐量。

papers.title: Virtual Head Attention
papers.summary: The design of attention mechanisms in long-context large language models faces an ``impossible triangle'' among KV cache size, training and prefill FLOPs, and model quality. GQA achieves strong quality but incurs high KV cache overhead; alternative approaches such as MLA and MFA can compress the cache, but MLA suffers from quality loss while MFA substantially increases training and prefill compute. We propose Virtual Head Attention (VHA), which simultaneously improves all three vertices through two lightweight linear operations: Q Premix applies a near-identity transformation to queries within each KV group to recover virtual head diversity from halved physical query heads, and Linear Postmix fuses inter-head features via a low-rank $I + AB^\top$ residual structure. Since VHA introduces no nonlinear operations, Premix can be folded into the query projection and Postmix into the output projection at inference time, reducing the model to a standard GQA-2 architecture that directly reuses all existing GQA inference optimizations. With only two KV heads, the group size in large models readily reaches 64, fully exploiting Tensor Core parallelism during decoding. Across four scales with 4K-context 50B-token pretraining, VHA consistently surpasses the standard GQA baseline at every scale ($+$0.05\% to $+$0.81\%), while reducing KV cache by $4\times$ vs.\ GQA-8 at dense scales and $2\times$ vs.\ GQA-4 at the MoE scale, and lowering training and prefill FLOPs by 7.9\% (1.7B, $S{=}4096$). On an industrial 30B-A3B MoE model trained on 500B tokens at 8K context, VHA outperforms both MLA and GQA-4 by $+$0.70\,/\,$+$2.60\,\% on a 12-benchmark base-model evaluation suite; in a separate matched 10B-A1B MoE comparison after long-context mid-training, VHA attains an average RULER score of 84.4 over 8K--128K versus 73.0 for GQA, while using two rather than four KV heads in the full-attention layers.
papers.comment: Published as a main conference paper at NeurIPS 2026

quality.verdict: 思路务实且有工程价值，但证据仍需更严谨外推。
pros: 针对KV缓存、计算与质量三难给出统一改进路径，工程可落地性强

papers.title_zh: 虚拟头部注意力
papers.summary_zh: 长上下文大语言模型中的注意力机制设计面临着 KV 缓存大小、训练和预填充 FLOP 以及模型质量之间的“不可能三角”。 GQA 质量较高，但 KV 缓存开销较高； MLA 和 MFA 等替代方法可以压缩缓存，但 MLA 会遭受质量损失，而 MFA 则大大增加了训练和预填充计算。我们提出虚拟头注意力（VHA），它通过两个轻量级线性操作同时改进所有三个顶点：Q Premix 对每个 KV 组内的查询应用近似恒等变换，以从减半的物理查询头恢复虚拟头多样性，而线性后混合通过低秩 $I + AB^\top$ 残差结构融合头间特征。由于 VHA 不引入非线性操作，因此可以在推理时将 Premix 折叠到查询投影中，将 Postmix 折叠到输出投影中，从而将模型简化为标准 GQA-2 架构，直接重用所有现有的 GQA 推理优化。由于只有两个 KV 头，大型模型中的组大小很容易达到 64，在解码过程中充分利用 Tensor Core 并行性。在具有 4K 上下文 50B 令牌预训练的四个规模中，VHA 在每个规模上始终超过标准 GQA 基线（$+$0.05\% 到 $+$0.81\%），同时在密集规模下将 KV 缓存减少 $4\times$ 与 GQA-8 相比，在 MoE 规模上将 KV 缓存减少 $2\times$ 与 GQA-4 相比，并将训练和预填充 FLOP 降低7.9%（1.7B，$S{=}4096$）。在 8K 上下文中使用 500B 代币训练的工业 30B-A3B MoE 模型上，VHA 在 12 基准模型评估套件上的性能优于 MLA 和 GQA-4 $+$0.70\,/\,$+$2.60\,\%；在长上下文中期训练后的单独匹配 10B-A1B MoE 比较中，VHA 在 8K--128K 上获得了 84.4 的平均 RULER 分数，而 GQA 为 73.0，同时在全注意力层中使用两个而不是四个 KV 头。

papers.title: HaloBlock: Faster and Better Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have attracted increasing research attention due to their bidirectional attention and arbitrary order decoding. However, there are two issues in dLLMs inference: the decoding difficulty is dominated by the tokens on the right side of the block, and the block-wise decoding inherently suffers from boundary contextual discontinuity. To tackle these limitations, we propose HaloBlock, a difficulty-aware adaptive halo mechanism for dLLM inference. We first leverage bidirectional cumulative entropy to characterize block decoding difficulty. Then, based on the bidirectional decoding difficulty, we adaptively allocate bidirectional halo regions on both sides of each block to mitigate boundary contextual discontinuity. The difficulty-aware design of HaloBlock smooths cross-block context propagation and lowers decoding difficulty for hard tokens, yielding better generation quality and faster convergence. Evaluated on LLaDA-8B-Instruct, Dream-7B-Instruct and LLaDA-1.5 across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, HaloBlock demonstrates consistent accuracy improvements and higher inference efficiency. Source codes are publicly available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/HaloBlock.

papers.title_zh: HaloBlock：更快更好地解码扩散大型语言模型
papers.summary_zh: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）由于其双向注意力和任意顺序解码而吸引了越来越多的研究关注。然而，dLLM 推理存在两个问题：解码难度主要由块右侧的标记决定，并且按块解码本质上会受到边界上下文不连续性的影响。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了 HaloBlock，一种用于 dLLM 推理的难度感知自适应光环机制。我们首先利用双向累积熵来表征块解码难度。然后，根据双向解码难度，我们自适应地在每个块的两侧分配双向光环区域，以减轻边界上下文不连续性。 HaloBlock 的难度感知设计可平滑跨区块上下文传播并降低硬代币的解码难度，从而产生更好的生成质量和更快的收敛速度。 HaloBlock 在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct、Dream-7B-Instruct 和 LLaDA-1.5 的数学推理和代码生成基准上进行了评估，展示了一致的准确性改进和更高的推理效率。源代码可在 https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/HaloBlock 上公开获取。

papers.title: CineMem: Attention-Aligned Fine-grained Memory Retrieval for Multi-Shot Long Video Generation
papers.summary: Autoregressive video generation relies on memory retrieval to model long-range dependencies. This capability becomes particularly critical for multi-shot generation, where models must reconcile substantial visual changes across shot transitions with persistent semantic continuity. Existing methods tend to perform memory retrieval at the frame level and share the same historical context across all query tokens, overlooking the heterogeneous information needs and leading to redundant retrieval and inefficient use of historical memory. To bridge this gap, we introduce CineMem, an attention-aligned fine-grained memory retrieval framework that combines online memory organization with query-adaptive retrieval for autoregressive multi-shot video generation. Specifically, guided by intrinsic memory-access patterns revealed through attention analysis, we propose an online-clustered KV cache as a memory organization strategy over all historical tokens, enabling semantic-aware memory grouping and more precise retrieval. In addition, we introduce a query-level retrieval mechanism that provides broader access to historical information under a fixed retrieval budget, thereby improving long-term memory utilization. Together, these designs enable the multi-shot video generator to preserve long-range consistency across shot transitions, particularly in revisitation scenarios, while approximating full-memory access under a constrained memory budget. To facilitate evaluation, we further introduce a suite of task-specific, VLM-assisted metrics for faithful inter-shot consistency assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.

papers.title_zh: CineMem：用于多镜头长视频生成的注意力对齐细粒度内存检索
papers.summary_zh: 自回归视频生成依赖于内存检索来模拟远程依赖性。此功能对于多镜头生成尤为重要，其中模型必须协调镜头过渡中的大量视觉变化与持久的语义连续性。现有方法倾向于在帧级别执行内存检索，并在所有查询标记之间共享相同的历史上下文，忽略了异构信息需求，导致冗余检索和历史内存的低效使用。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了 CineMem，这是一种注意力对齐的细粒度内存检索框架，它将在线内存组织与查询自适应检索相结合，用于自回归多镜头视频生成。具体来说，在通过注意力分析揭示的内在内存访问模式的指导下，我们提出了一种在线集群 KV 缓存作为所有历史标记的内存组织策略，从而实现语义感知内存分组和更精确的检索。此外，我们引入了查询级检索机制，可以在固定的检索预算下提供对历史信息的更广泛的访问，从而提高长期内存利用率。这些设计共同使多镜头视频生成器能够在镜头转换之间保持远程一致性，特别是在重访场景中，同时在有限的内存预算下接近全内存访问。为了便于评估，我们进一步引入了一套特定于任务的 VLM 辅助指标，用于忠实的镜头间一致性评估。大量的实验证明了我们框架的有效性。

papers.title: Batch-Paced: Fixed-Budget Batch Decoding in Discrete Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: As generative language models become more capable and widely used, inference demand grows, making efficient serving increasingly important. Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer a promising path to more efficient inference through parallel token generation. Prior dLLM decoding methods, however, focus on improving inference efficiency for individual sequences. We formulate fixed-budget dLLM batch decoding and introduce Batch-Paced, a training-free method that jointly optimizes the allocation of decoding compute across requests to improve overall batch quality. Across two dLLM backbones, five benchmarks and their representative mixtures, Batch-Paced improves batch performance under matched budgets; gains generally grow with batch size and largely persist across decoding configurations. Analysis of requests' decoding trajectories suggests that these gains arise largely by raising the committed-token confidence of lower-confidence requests. We further show that Batch-Paced's batch decode time remains competitive and that adding a decoding-depth allowance during Batch-Paced decoding can shorten it further at a modest performance cost.

papers.title_zh: 批量节奏：离散扩散语言模型中的固定预算批量解码
papers.summary_zh: 随着生成语言模型的能力变得越来越强大并得到广泛使用，推理需求不断增长，使得高效服务变得越来越重要。离散扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 为通过并行标记生成进行更有效的推理提供了一条有希望的途径。然而，先前的 dLLM 解码方法侧重于提高单个序列的推理效率。我们制定了固定预算 dLLM 批量解码，并引入了 Batch-Paced，这是一种免训练方法，可联合优化跨请求的解码计算分配，以提高整体批量质量。 Batch-Paced 在两个 dLLM 主干、五个基准及其代表性混合物中提高了匹配预算下的批量性能；增益通常随着批量大小而增长，并且在解码配置中很大程度上持续存在。对请求解码轨迹的分析表明，这些收益主要是通过提高较低置信度请求的承诺令牌置信度来实现的。我们进一步表明，Batch-Paced 的批量解码时间仍然具有竞争力，并且在 Batch-Paced 解码期间添加解码深度限额可以以适度的性能成本进一步缩短时间。

papers.title: FlashMask-3: Efficient and Expressive Mask-Aware Distributed Attention
papers.summary: Long-context training of large language and multimodal models couples structured attention masks (document, prefix-LM, share-question, sliding-window, block-sparse) with multi-node context parallelism, making the mask a dominant bottleneck. FlashMask's column-wise sparse mask compresses them from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n)$ via four query-axis boundary vectors, covering broad structured patterns. Implemented for Ampere GPUs, it neither exploits FlashAttention-3's TMA/WGMMA warp-specialized pipeline on Hopper nor supports distribution. The column-wise sparse mask is indexed by key positions but stores query-axis interval boundaries. Under any multi-chunk context-parallel assignment, it reduces per-rank mask localization to a provably zero-communication \emph{clip--shift--max} on the boundary vectors, compatible with the single-GPU kernel. FlashMask-3 introduces a mask-aware Hopper kernel with three-role warp specialization atop FlashAttention-3's TMA/WGMMA pipeline, plus a mask-aware distributed extension: zero-communication mask localization, a sparsity-aware load balancer (HCC-IPO), and a mask-aware compute-communication overlap with mask-driven communication pruning, whose forward all-gather uses topology-aware hierarchical routing. On a single H100 across 12 masks at 4K--128K context, it improves achieved TFLOPs over FlashMask, FlexAttention, and MagiAttention by 45--141%, 34--71%, and 2--44%. At context-parallel degrees 4--32 with 8K sequence per device, it attains 31--75% compute-communication overlap efficiency and improves throughput over Megatron-Core CP ring, Megatron-Core CP all-gather, and MagiAttention by $1.80\times$--$3.71\times$, $1.71\times$--$2.92\times$, and $1.09\times$--$1.46\times$. In end-to-end training of a 118B-A14B MoE at 128K on 128 H100 GPUs, it raises throughput by 7.3--11.0% over a Dual Chunk all-gather baseline, with attention forward+backward 24.5--44.9% faster.
papers.comment: Published as a main conference paper at NeurIPS 2026

papers.title_zh: FlashMask-3：高效且富有表现力的掩模感知分布式注意力
papers.summary_zh: 大语言和多模态模型的长上下文训练将结构化注意掩码（文档、前缀LM、共享问题、滑动窗口、块稀疏）与多节点上下文并行性结合起来，使掩码成为主要瓶颈。 FlashMask 的按列稀疏掩码通过四个查询轴边界向量将它们从 $O(n^2)$ 压缩到 $O(n)$，涵盖广泛的结构化模式。它是为 Ampere GPU 实现的，既不利用 Hopper 上 FlashAttention-3 的 TMA/WGMMA 扭曲专用管道，也不支持分发。按列稀疏掩码按关键位置索引，但存储查询轴间隔边界。在任何多块上下文并行分配下，它将每秩掩码定位减少到边界向量上可证明的零通信 \emph{clip--shift--max} ，与单 GPU 内核兼容。 FlashMask-3 在 FlashAttention-3 的 TMA/WGMMA 管道上引入了具有三角色扭曲专业化的掩码感知 Hopper 内核，以及掩码感知分布式扩展：零通信掩码本地化、稀疏感知负载均衡器 (HCC-IPO) 以及掩码感知计算通信与掩码驱动通信修剪的重叠，其前向全收集使用拓扑感知分层路由。在 4K--128K 环境下跨 12 个掩模的单个 H100 上，它比 FlashMask、FlexAttention 和 MagiAttention 实现的 TFLOP 提高了 45--141%、34--71% 和 2--44%。在每台设备 8K 序列的上下文并行度 4--32 下，它实现了 31--75% 的计算通信重叠效率，并将 Megatron-Core CP 环、Megatron-Core CP all-gather 和 MagiAttention 的吞吐量提高了 $1.80\times$--$3.71\times$、$1.71\times$--$2.92\times$，以及$1.09\times$--$1.46\times$。在 128 个 H100 GPU 上以 128K 进行 118B-A14B MoE 的端到端训练中，与双块全收集基线相比，吞吐量提高了 7.3--11.0%，注意力向前+向后速度提高了 24.5--44.9%。

papers.title: MMTA: Benchmarking Multimodal Temporal Analysis with Time Series, Text, and Vision
papers.summary: Time-series analysis is increasingly studied in multimodal settings, yet most benchmarks pair temporal signals with text or with visualizations derived from the same signal. This leaves open whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can integrate time series with real-world visual evidence. We introduce MMTA (multimodal temporal analysis), a benchmark of tri-modal tasks with diverse cross-modal complementarity patterns among time series, text, and vision. MMTA spans nine domains -- robotics, autonomous driving, human action, manufacturing, AR assistance, healthcare, recommendation, finance, and climate -- under video+TS and image+TS layouts, with a 3,524-sample test split covering classification and forecasting. The benchmark standardizes heterogeneous real-world sources into a shared schema with domain-specific prompts, provenance documentation, and success-weighted metrics that penalize both wrong answers and failed generations. Evaluating eight open-source and proprietary MLLMs reveals a shared bottleneck: representing time series as text creates very long token sequences and weakens fine-grained alignment with visual evidence, especially in long-video settings. We then introduce TimeOmni-v, a multimodal LLM extension with a dedicated time-series encoder, temporal positional alignment, modality-aware token layout, and a forecasting head. TimeOmni-v improves long-video classification and time-series inference efficiency, showing that MMTA not only exposes representation and grounding failures but also motivates targeted model design.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Project page: https://windowso.github.io/MMTA/

papers.title_zh: MMTA：使用时间序列、文本和视觉对多模态时间分析进行基准测试
papers.summary_zh: 时间序列分析在多模态设置中得到越来越多的研究，但大多数基准将时间信号与文本或从同一信号派生的可视化配对。这使得多模态大语言模型（MLLM）是否能够将时间序列与现实世界的视觉证据相整合尚不确定。我们引入了 MMTA（多模态时间分析），这是三模态任务的基准，在时间序列、文本和视觉之间具有多种跨模态互补模式。 MMTA 跨越机器人、自动驾驶、人类行为、制造、AR 辅助、医疗保健、推荐、金融和气候九个领域，采用视频+TS 和图像+TS 布局，3,524 个样本测试分割涵盖分类和预测。该基准将异构的现实世界源标准化为一个共享模式，其中包含特定于域的提示、出处文档和成功加权指标，这些指标会惩罚错误的答案和失败的生成。评估八个开源和专有的 MLLM 揭示了一个共同的瓶颈：将时间序列表示为文本会创建非常长的标记序列，并削弱与视觉证据的细粒度对齐，尤其是在长视频设置中。然后，我们介绍 TimeOmni-v，这是一个多模态 LLM 扩展，具有专用时间序列编码器、时间位置对齐、模态感知令牌布局和预测头。 TimeOmni-v 提高了长视频分类和时间序列推理效率，表明 MMTA 不仅暴露了表示和接地故障，而且还激发了有针对性的模型设计。

papers.title: Quota-Based Aging for Prediction-Guided Scheduling in LLM Serving
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) serving systems use token-level continuous batching to improve resource utilization, but heterogeneous response lengths complicate request scheduling. Prediction-guided short-first scheduling reduces average latency but can severely delay long requests, while unrestricted aging may over-promote delayed long requests under congestion. We propose Quota-Based Aging (QBA), a lightweight policy that combines predicted short-first admission with quota-bounded, debt-enforced promotion of aged predicted-long requests. We also use a reduced M/G/n queueing surrogate, calibrated from simulator traces, to explain first-order mean-latency trends. QBA is evaluated using a serving-aware event-driven simulator that models decode-priority batching, chunked prefill, token-budget constraints, and KV-cache-safe admission. We compare QBA with FCFS, predicted short-first, and aggressive aging under asymmetric prediction errors on synthetic and production-derived workloads. The evaluation considers queueing delay, throughput, utilization, and class-conditional tail performance. Results show that QBA provides a controllable middle ground between aggressive short-first prioritization and unrestricted aging, substantially reducing long-request tail latency while retaining much of the mean-latency benefit of prediction-guided scheduling.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 10 figures. Accepted for publication at the 45th IEEE International Performance, Computing, and Communications Conference (IPCCC 2026), Austin, TX, November 2026

papers.title_zh: LLM 服务中预测引导调度的基于配额的老化
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）服务系统使用令牌级连续批处理来提高资源利用率，但异构响应长度使请求调度变得复杂。预测引导的短优先调度减少了平均延迟，但会严重延迟长请求，而无限制的老化可能会在拥塞情况下过度促进延迟的长请求。我们提出基于配额的时效（QBA），这是一种轻量级策略，它将预测的短优先接纳与对时效的预测长请求的配额限制、债务强制促进相结合。我们还使用根据模拟器轨迹进行校准的简化 M/G/n 排队代理来解释一阶平均延迟趋势。 QBA 使用服务感知事件驱动模拟器进行评估，该模拟器对解码优先级批处理、分块预填充、令牌预算约束和 KV 缓存安全准入进行建模。我们将 QBA 与 FCFS 进行比较，在合成和生产衍生工作负载的不对称预测错误下预测短优先和激进老化。评估考虑了排队延迟、吞吐量、利用率和类条件尾部性能。结果表明，QBA 在积极的短优先优先级和无限制老化之间提供了一个可控的中间立场，大大减少了长请求尾部延迟，同时保留了预测引导调度的大部分平均延迟优势。

papers.title: CacheSmith: Accurate RAG Serving under Latency SLOs with Adaptive KV Reuse
papers.summary: This paper presents CacheSmith, a KV cache reuse system for RAG prefill that maximizes quality-gated SLO attainment. While context caching lowers prefill latency by reusing precomputed KV states for retrieved chunks, it misses cross-chunk attention that a full prefill would compute over concatenated inputs. Prior selective recomputation schemes tackle this problem but enforce static, one-size-fits-all configurations that fail to effectively handle request heterogeneity or dynamic latency budgets. CacheSmith decomposes selective recomputation into a three-phase workflow of WarmUp, Probe, and Patch that can be dynamically configured to exploit a wide range of cost-accuracy trade-offs. At serving time, an SLO-aware scheduler in CacheSmith forms batches to mitigate inter-request interference during layer-by-layer prefill, while a budget-aware planner configures recomputation phases across the batch to maximize the number of requests satisfying both generation quality and latency targets. Both components make fast, solver-free decisions over profiled cost-accuracy bands. On four benchmarks across varying arrival rates and burstiness levels, CacheSmith improves quality-gated SLO attainment by up to 27.5%, over four state-of-the-art baselines.

papers.title_zh: CacheSmith：通过自适应 KV 重用在延迟 SLO 下提供准确的 RAG 服务
papers.summary_zh: 本文介绍了 CacheSmith，这是一种用于 RAG 预填充的 KV 缓存重用系统，可最大限度地实现质量控制的 SLO。虽然上下文缓存通过重用检索块的预计算 KV 状态来降低预填充延迟，但它错过了完整预填充将在连接输入上进行计算的跨块注意力。先前的选择性重新计算方案解决了这个问题，但强制执行静态的、一刀切的配置，无法有效地处理请求异构性或动态延迟预算。 CacheSmith 将选择性重新计算分解为 WarmUp、Probe 和 Patch 的三阶段工作流程，可以动态配置该工作流程以利用各种成本精度权衡。在服务时，CacheSmith 中的 SLO 感知调度程序会形成批次，以减轻逐层预填充期间的请求间干扰，而预算感知规划器会跨批次配置重新计算阶段，以最大限度地提高满足生成质量和延迟目标的请求数量。这两个组件都可以在分析的成本精度范围内做出快速、无需求解器的决策。在涉及不同到达率和突发性水平的四个基准上，CacheSmith 将质量控制的 SLO 达到率提高了 27.5%，超过了四个最先进的基准。

papers.title: Foundation Models for Event Prediction Across Heterogeneous Event Logs
papers.summary: Event logs are ubiquitous across real-world domains, including business processes, manufacturing workflows, healthcare, and many other operational systems. Yet event logs can differ substantially in their event semantics, label spaces, interaction patterns, and temporal scales, making it difficult to build a single foundation model that generalizes directly to previously unseen systems. We address this challenge with the Foundation Event Predictor (FEP), a simple and scalable in-context architecture that performs next-event prediction through learned, event-level nonparametric inference. Causal self-attention encodes context and target histories into key and query representations, respectively, while the observed next context events are encoded as values. Cross-attention then performs learned, relevance-weighted aggregation of next-event outcomes over all context transitions, allowing the entire nonparametric prediction procedure to be expressed as standard attention operations and efficiently parallelized with modern kernels such as FlashAttention. To promote cross-system generalization, we introduce permutation-robust embedding learning and random fixed embeddings to decouple event IDs from persistent semantics, together with empirical quantile transforms and robust normalization to handle diverse temporal scales. We pretrain FEP on 696 real-world event datasets spanning heterogeneous event systems and evaluate it on 50 held-out datasets unseen during pretraining. Across these datasets, FEP generalizes effectively to new event systems without parameter adaptation, frequently approaching the performance of strong models trained separately on each target dataset while substantially outperforming existing foundation-model baselines, particularly on challenging prediction tasks.

papers.title_zh: 跨异构事件日志的事件预测的基础模型
papers.summary_zh: 事件日志在现实世界中无处不在，包括业务流程、制造工作流程、医疗保健和许多其他操作系统。然而，事件日志在事件语义、标签空间、交互模式和时间尺度上可能存在很大差异，因此很难构建直接推广到以前未见过的系统的单一基础模型。我们使用基础事件预测器 (FEP) 来应对这一挑战，这是一种简单且可扩展的上下文架构，可通过学习的事件级非参数推理来执行下一个事件预测。因果自注意力将上下文和目标历史分别编码为键和查询表示，而观察到的下一个上下文事件被编码为值。然后，交叉注意力在所有上下文转换上对下一个事件结果执行学习的、相关性加权的聚合，从而允许整个非参数预测过程表示为标准注意力操作，并与 FlashAttention 等现代内核有效并行。为了促进跨系统泛化，我们引入了排列鲁棒嵌入学习和随机固定嵌入，以将事件 ID 与持久语义分离，同时引入经验分位数变换和鲁棒归一化来处理不同的时间尺度。我们在跨异构事件系统的 696 个真实事件数据集上对 FEP 进行预训练，并在预训练期间未见过的 50 个保留数据集上对其进行评估。在这些数据集中，FEP 可以有效地推广到无需参数调整的新事件系统，经常接近在每个目标数据集上单独训练的强大模型的性能，同时大大优于现有的基础模型基线，特别是在具有挑战性的预测任务上。

papers.title: When Goals Leak Across Relationships: How Cached Goal Representations Shape Cross-Client Decisions
papers.summary: As LLM agents take on more autonomous roles, they may interact with multiple clients and counterparties whose goals and incentives conflict. If an agent maintains shared inference state across these interactions, information associated with one relationship may influence decisions made for another. We test OLMo-3-7B-Instruct in a controlled two-client environment with 20 market scenarios, where each client is assigned an opposing objective. With shared conversational memory, the model deviates from the current client's objective in 22% of eligible decisions. We then investigate how these goals are represented in the KV cache. Linear probes show that client-goal ownership becomes highly recoverable in middle layers and is concentrated in particular attention heads. We use these results to identify where to intervene in the cache and test whether these representations affect the model's decisions. Ablating the competitor's cached goal representations at these locations shifts the model toward the current client. The effect is larger for heads identified by probing than for randomly selected heads, and larger when ablating goal tokens than matched non-goal tokens from the same client. Our results show that client-specific goal representations persist in the KV cache and can causally influence decisions made for other clients, highlighting the importance of relationship-specific state isolation in persistent LLM agents.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshops on Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB) and Agents in the Wild (AIWild)

papers.title_zh: 当目标在关系中泄漏时：缓存的目标表示如何影响跨客户端决策
papers.summary_zh: 随着法学硕士代理人承担更多自主角色，他们可能会与目标和激励发生冲突的多个客户和交易对手进行互动。如果代理在这些交互中保持共享的推理状态，则与一种关系相关的信息可能会影响为另一种关系做出的决策。我们在具有 20 个市场场景的受控双客户端环境中测试 OLMo-3-7B-Instruct，其中每个客户端都被分配了一个相反的目标。通过共享对话记忆，该模型有 22% 的合格决策偏离了当前客户的目标。然后我们研究这些目标是如何在 KV 缓存中表示的。线性探针表明，客户目标所有权在中间层变得高度可恢复，并且集中在特定的注意力头中。我们使用这些结果来确定在缓存中进行干预的位置，并测试这些表示是否会影响模型的决策。消除竞争对手在这些位置缓存的目标表示会将模型转向当前客户端。通过探测识别的头的效果比随机选择的头的效果更大，并且当消融目标令牌时比来自同一客户端的匹配的非目标令牌更大。我们的结果表明，特定于客户端的目标表示持续存在于 KV 缓存中，并且可以因果性地影响为其他客户端所做的决策，这凸显了持久性 LLM 代理中特定于关系的状态隔离的重要性。

papers.title: Budgeted KV-Cache Repair for Evolving Contexts
papers.summary: Language-model agents revise their working context as information becomes obsolete, but deleting text does not erase its influence on cached computation. Later key-value (KV) states remain conditioned on the deleted content, while recomputing the entire retained suffix can be costly. We introduce budgeted KV-cache repair: recovering task performance by recomputing a user-chosen fraction of the retained suffix. Comparing repair allocations under identical relevance scores and token budgets, we find that refreshing coherent regions can substantially outperform refreshing isolated tokens. This finding motivates Semantic-Unit Refresh (SUR), which allocates the budget to query-relevant text regions using inexpensive embedding scores, without training or an auxiliary transformer forward. To execute these repairs efficiently, a layer-packed executor processes selected states together at each layer while preserving full causal cache access. Across five models, SUR achieves strong recovery in controlled deletion tasks while recomputing only 2-5% of the suffix. On four natural multi-hop QA datasets, it achieves near-full-recompute exact match at a 5% budget with lower post-edit latency. The executor accelerates fragmented refresh by up to 16.1x over interval-wise execution.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法实用但验证仍需更扎实。
pros: 提出预算化KV修复，兼顾性能恢复与延迟成本

papers.title_zh: 针对不断变化的上下文的预算 KV 缓存修复
papers.summary_zh: 当信息过时时，语言模型代理会修改其工作上下文，但删除文本并不会消除其对缓存计算的影响。稍后的键值 (KV) 状态仍以已删除的内容为条件，而重新计算整个保留的后缀可能成本高昂。我们引入预算 KV 缓存修复：通过重新计算用户选择的保留后缀部分来恢复任务性能。比较相同相关性分数和令牌预算下的修复分配，我们发现刷新相干区域可以大大优于刷新孤立令牌。这一发现激发了语义单元刷新（SUR），它使用廉价的嵌入分数将预算分配给与查询相关的文本区域，无需训练或辅助变压器转发。为了有效地执行这些修复，分层执行器在每一层一起处理选定的状态，同时保留完整的因果缓存访问。在五个模型中，SUR 在受控删除任务中实现了强大的恢复，同时仅重新计算 2-5% 的后缀。在四个自然多跳 QA 数据集上，它以 5% 的预算实现了近乎完全重新计算的精确匹配，并具有较低的编辑后延迟。与间隔执行相比，执行器将碎片刷新速度提高了 16.1 倍。

papers.title: MLAfication: Efficiently Enabling High-Fidelity MLA for Modern LLMs
papers.summary: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) compresses the KV cache into a latent representation, reducing inference memory and bandwidth. Existing MHA2MLA/TransMLA methods do not support QKNorm and require costly recovery on modern LLMs, especially MoE. We present MLAfication, a QKNorm-compatible, parameter-efficient extension of MHA2MLA. It combines calibrated KNorm, parameter-efficient distillation, contribution-aware Partial-RoPE, and activation-aware joint KV initialization. Across MHA and GQA models, including QKNorm- and MoE-equipped variants, MLAfication preserves performance under substantial KV-cache compression, surpasses the current SOTA on commonsense and long-context benchmarks, and extends MLA conversion to modern architectures. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, MLAfication delivers up to $5.35\times$ the serving throughput of BF16 GQA and, combined with 4-bit KV quantization, reduces the KV-cache footprint by $94.73\%$. Our code is available at https://github.com/JT-Ushio/MLAfication.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 面向现代LLM的实用改进，价值高但证据仍需加固。
pros: 针对QKNorm与MoE等现实痛点提出兼容方案，工程相关性强
