papers.title_zh: MLAfication：为现代法学硕士有效实现高保真 MLA
papers.summary_zh: 多头潜在注意力 (MLA) 将 KV 缓存压缩为潜在表示，从而减少推理内存和带宽。现有的 MHA2MLA/TransMLA 方法不支持 QKNorm，并且需要在现代法学硕士（尤其是 MoE）上进行昂贵的恢复。我们提出了 MLAfication，它是 MHA2MLA 的 QKNorm 兼容、参数高效的扩展。它结合了校准 KNorm、参数高效蒸馏、贡献感知 Partial-RoPE 和激活感知联合 KV 初始化。在 MHA 和 GQA 模型中，包括配备 QKNorm 和 MoE 的变体，MLAfication 在大量 KV 缓存压缩下保留了性能，在常识和长上下文基准上超越了当前的 SOTA，并将 MLA 转换扩展到现代架构。在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上，MLAfication 可提供 BF16 GQA 服务吞吐量高达 5.35 美元\times$，并与 4 位 KV 量化相结合，将 KV 缓存占用空间减少 94.73 美元\%$。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/JT-Ushio/MLAfication 获取。

papers.title: FORGE: Procedural Weight Generation for Sparse MoE Inference
papers.summary: We introduce FORGE (Fast On-chip Rotor Generation for Experts), a procedural weight generation system for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference. Rather than storing and loading every expert weight tensor from HBM, we show how a compact accelerator inside each Streaming Multiprocessor can regenerate them on-the-fly from $O(\log^2 d)$ rotor parameters per projection. Per replaced layer, gigabytes of stored expert weights are approximated with under a megabyte of seeds. This addresses the dual memory bottleneck of autoregressive Sparse MoE decode, where per-expert FFN operations are HBM-bandwidth-bound at small routed-token counts and the aggregate expert footprint forces multi-node Expert Parallelism (EP) with all-to-all traffic. We realize the approach as the Rotor Generation Unit (RGU), a fixed-function datapath that generates FFN weight tiles without competing with Tensor Core execution. With 30% of the MoE FFN layers replaced across five Sparse MoE models, we estimate 1.3-2.8x higher system throughput at matched GPU count and 1.10-1.15x lower per-user decode latency at short context. In exchange, downstream accuracy on three model families falls below that of the same model fine-tuned without rotor replacement, and the replacement ratio controls this tradeoff. FORGE also expands KV cache capacity by 1.2-2.6x. It is agnostic to the bit width at which weights are stored, so it can compose with quantization. The RGU is fully implemented/verified in SystemVerilog at ~0.9% SM area overhead (0.032 mm^2/SM, 7nm).

quality.verdict: 思路新颖且系统价值高，但实证严谨性不足。
pros: 以程序化生成替代专家权重存储，显著缓解MoE显存与带宽瓶颈
给出可落地硬件实现（RGU）并报告低面积开销，系统视角完整

papers.title_zh: FORGE：稀疏 MoE 推理的程序权重生成
papers.summary_zh: 我们介绍 FORGE（专家快速片上转子生成），这是一种用于稀疏专家混合 (MoE) 推理的程序权重生成系统。我们展示了每个流多处理器内的紧凑加速器如何从每个投影的 $O(\log^2 d)$ 转子参数动态重新生成它们，而不是存储和加载 HBM 中的每个专家权重张量。每个替换层存储的专家权重为千兆字节，种子数量约为一兆字节。这解决了自回归稀疏 MoE 解码的双内存瓶颈，其中每个专家 FFN 操作在小路由令牌计数时受到 HBM 带宽限制，并且聚合专家占用空间迫使多节点专家并行 (EP) 具有所有到所有流量。我们将该方法实现为转子生成单元 (RGU)，这是一种固定功能数据路径，可生成 FFN 权重块，而不与 Tensor Core 执行竞争。通过在五个稀疏 MoE 模型中替换 30% 的 MoE FFN 层，我们估计在匹配的 GPU 数量下系统吞吐量提高了 1.3-2.8 倍，在短上下文下每用户解码延迟降低了 1.10-1.15 倍。作为交换，三个模型系列的下游精度低于未更换转子而微调的同一模型的下游精度，并且更换率控制了这种权衡。 FORGE 还将 KV 缓存容量扩展了 1.2-2.6 倍。它与存储权重的位宽无关，因此它可以与量化相结合。 RGU 在 SystemVerilog 中完全实现/验证，SM 面积开销约为 0.9%（0.032 mm^2/SM，7nm）。

papers.title: A Scaled-Up Empirical Study of Syntactic Language Models
papers.summary: Syntactic language models (SLMs) that generate sentences along with their syntactic tree structures have shown promise in both syntactic generalization and downstream tasks. Prior studies, however, have mostly evaluated smaller models trained on less pretraining data and tested on narrower task suites. In addition, the design space of tree linearization and attention masks remains underexplored. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of 12 controlled configurations---one terminal baseline and 11 SLM variants spanning different linearizations and masks---at scales up to 1B parameters and 100B training tokens, evaluated across 11 downstream tasks and two syntactic benchmarks. The experimental results show that SLMs with standard causal attention match or exceed structural-mask variants across downstream and syntactic benchmarks. They require no architectural modifications and remain compatible with FlashAttention. We also observe that when scaling up to the 1B-parameter scale, the top-performing SLM variant no longer shows a clear advantage over a compute-matched non-structural baseline, suggesting that SLMs may become less competitive with scale. Our code is available at https://github.com/qlwpc/TG-Interpolation.

quality.verdict: 规模化实证扎实，但方法创新与结论外推有限。

papers.title_zh: 句法语言模型的大规模实证研究
papers.summary_zh: 生成句子及其句法树结构的句法语言模型（SLM）在句法泛化和下游任务中都显示出了前景。然而，之前的研究大多评估了在较少预训练数据上训练的较小模型，并在较窄的任务套件上进行了测试。此外，树线性化和注意力掩模的设计空间仍未得到充分探索。我们对 12 种受控配置（一个终端基线和 11 个跨越不同线性化和掩码的 SLM 变体）进行了大规模实证研究，规模高达 1B 个参数和 100B 个训练标记，并在 11 个下游任务和两个句法基准上进行了评估。实验结果表明，具有标准因果注意力的 SLM 在下游和句法基准上匹配或超过结构掩码变体。它们不需要架构修改并与 FlashAttention 保持兼容。我们还观察到，当扩展到 1B 参数规模时，性能最好的 SLM 变体不再显示出比计算匹配的非结构基线明显的优势，这表明 SLM 可能会随着规模的扩大而变得不那么有竞争力。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/qlwpc/TG-Interpolation 获取。

papers.title: Prorsa: Unleashing the Potential of Prefill-Decode Disaggregation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) is commonly used to enhance the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in solving complex multi-turn tasks. During rollout, agentic RL exhibits a workload pattern distinct from that of traditional RL: multi-turn interactions repeatedly introduce prefill requests, causing prefill and decode workloads to coexist throughout rollout. This workload makes prefill-decode (PD) disaggregation, a design widely used for online LLM serving, promising for speeding up agentic RL rollout. This paper shows that PD disaggregation can improve rollout efficiency by (a) mitigating interference among data-parallel attention modules, (b) enabling stage-specific parallelism, and (c) reducing end-to-end trajectory completion time. However, a fixed prefill-decode allocation may fail to sustain these benefits as workload composition varies across tasks and over time. We therefore present Prorsa, an agentic RL framework for prediction-guided prefill-decode resource allocation. Prorsa observes the lifecycle of every trajectory to forecast short-horizon prefill and decode demand. These forecasts then guide worker allocation decisions and trigger role switching of rollout engines, aligning prefill and decode capacity with anticipated workload demand. Across synchronous and asynchronous agentic RL settings, Prorsa achieves end-to-end rollout speedups of 1.11x-4.05x over prefill-decode colocation.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方案有新意但证据仍偏摘要级。
pros: 将在线服务中的PD解耦系统化引入Agentic RL rollout，问题定义准确且有现实价值。
提出预测引导的动态资源分配与角色切换机制，并在同步/异步场景报告了可观加速。
cons: 当前仅见吞吐/时延增益声明，缺少对预测误差鲁棒性、切换开销及跨模型泛化的严格消融与统计显著性信息。

papers.title_zh: Prorsa：释放代理强化学习中预填充解码分解的潜力
papers.summary_zh: 代理强化学习（RL）通常用于增强大型语言模型（LLM）解决复杂多轮任务的能力。在推出期间，代理强化学习表现出与传统强化学习不同的工作负载模式：多轮交互重复引入预填充请求，导致预填充和解码工作负载在整个推出过程中共存。这种工作负载使得预填充解码 (PD) 分解成为一种广泛用于在线 LLM 服务的设计，有望加速代理 RL 的推出。本文表明，PD 分解可以通过以下方式提高推出效率：(a) 减轻数据并行注意模块之间的干扰，(b) 实现阶段特定的并行性，以及 (c) 减少端到端轨迹完成时间。然而，固定的预填充解码分配可能无法维持这些优势，因为工作负载组成随任务和时间的推移而变化。因此，我们提出了 Prorsa，一种用于预测引导的预填充解码资源分配的代理强化学习框架。 Prorsa 观察每个轨迹的生命周期，以预测短期预填充和解码需求。然后，这些预测指导工作人员分配决策并触发部署引擎的角色切换，使预填充和解码容量与预期工作负载需求保持一致。在同步和异步代理 RL 设置中，Prorsa 的端到端部署速度比预填充解码托管提高了 1.11 倍至 4.05 倍。

papers.title: LoopQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Looped Transformers
papers.summary: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) improve parameter efficiency by recursively reusing shared Transformer modules, yet their repeated computation over evolving recurrent states poses new challenges for low-bit deployment. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods, largely designed for feed-forward Transformers, fail to account for cross-loop activation dynamics, heterogeneous loop sensitivity, and recursive error propagation, leading to substantial performance degradation at low precision. To address these challenges, we propose LoopQuant, a loop-aware PTQ framework for accurate and efficient low-bit quantization of LoopLMs. LoopQuant is built on three core components: 1) Cross-Loop Distribution Canonicalization (CLDC) learns a shared quantization-friendly representation across recurrent states while preserving parameter sharing; 2) Interaction-Aware Loop-wise Precision Allocation (ILPA) allocates activation precision under a fixed bit budget by modeling task-level loop sensitivity and cross-loop interactions; and 3) Loop-Conditioned Task Calibration (LCTC) further aligns quantized inference with the low-bit recursive trajectory through lightweight task-space calibration. Extensive experiments across LoopLM architectures demonstrate that LoopQuant consistently outperforms existing low-bit PTQ methods. On Ouro-2.6B, LoopQuant under W4A4 surpasses all W4A8 baselines in performance, while reducing model memory by 65.3% with only 3.4% additional storage overhead over naive INT4 and achieving a 1.7 times decoding speedup over BF16. These results demonstrate a strong balance among accuracy, compression, and inference efficiency, providing a practical and deployment-friendly solution for low-bit LoopLM inference. The code is available at [https://github.com/Kishon-zzx/LoopQuant].

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 面向LoopLM量化痛点，方法完整且实用性强
pros: 准确抓住循环共享结构下PTQ失效机理，提出环路感知框架
兼顾精度、压缩与速度，给出W4A4优于W4A8基线的有竞争力结果

papers.title_zh: LoopQuant：环形变压器准确高效的训练后量化
papers.summary_zh: 循环语言模型 (LoopLM) 通过递归地重用共享 Transformer 模块来提高参数效率，但它们对不断演变的循环状态的重复计算给低位部署带来了新的挑战。现有的训练后量化（PTQ）方法主要是为前馈 Transformer 设计的，无法考虑跨环激活动态、异构环灵敏度和递归误差传播，导致低精度下性能大幅下降。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 LoopQuant，这是一种循环感知 PTQ 框架，用于对 LoopLM 进行准确且高效的低位量化。 LoopQuant 基于三个核心组件构建：1）跨循环分布规范化（CLDC）在保留参数共享的同时学习跨循环状态的共享量化友好表示； 2）交互感知循环精度分配（ILPA）通过对任务级循环敏感性和跨循环交互进行建模，在固定比特预算下分配激活精度； 3）循环条件任务校准（LCTC）通过轻量级任务空间校准进一步将量化推理与低位递归轨迹对齐。跨 LoopLM 架构的大量实验表明，LoopQuant 始终优于现有的低位 PTQ 方法。在 Ouro-2.6B 上，W4A4 下的 LoopQuant 在性能上超越了所有 W4A8 基准，同时将模型内存减少了 65.3%，仅比 naive INT4 增加了 3.4% 的额外存储开销，并实现了比 BF16 1.7 倍的解码加速。这些结果展示了准确性、压缩和推理效率之间的强大平衡，为低位 LoopLM 推理提供了实用且易于部署的解决方案。该代码可在 [https://github.com/Kishon-zzx/LoopQuant] 获取。

papers.title: Fast Quantized Johnson$-$Lindenstrauss Transforms
papers.summary: Quantization has emerged as one of the primary techniques for reducing the memory footprint of large language models during inference. A prominent example is Quantized Johnson$-$Lindenstrauss (QJL), which compresses KV caches using 1-bit asymmetric quantization while approximately preserving the inner products required by the attention mechanism. Recent theoretical and practical work aims at replacing the dense Gaussian projections used by the aforementioned transforms with more structured embeddings $-$ such as compositions of randomized Hadamard transforms $-$ while retaining the same embedding dimension. In this paper, we introduce two constructions based on a composition of randomized Hadamard transforms, albeit with a Gaussian rather than Rademacher diagonal in the second stage. The first adds Gaussian dithering to smooth the quantizer, while the second inserts a random permutation to regularize the covariance structure of the resulting Gaussian measurements. We prove embedding-dimension and running-time guarantees analogous to those of Fast JL in the non-quantized setting. The first construction achieves $m=O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log^2(d/δ))$, while the second achieves $m=O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log(d/δ))$ under a restriction on $m$. Both constructions can be applied in $O(d\log d)$ time.

quality.verdict: 理论扎实且实用导向强，但实证价值仍待验证

papers.title_zh: 快速量化 Johnson$-$Lindenstrauss 变换
papers.summary_zh: 量化已成为减少大型语言模型在推理过程中内存占用的主要技术之一。一个突出的例子是量化 Johnson$-$Lindenstrauss (QJL)，它使用 1 位非对称量化来压缩 KV 缓存，同时近似保留注意力机制所需的内积。最近的理论和实践工作旨在用更结构化的嵌入 $-$ 替换上述变换使用的密集高斯投影，例如随机哈达玛变换 $-$ 的组合，同时保留相同的嵌入维度。在本文中，我们介绍了两种基于随机哈达玛变换组合的结构，尽管在第二阶段使用高斯对角线而不是拉德马赫对角线。第一个添加高斯抖动以平滑量化器，而第二个插入随机排列以正则化所得高斯测量的协方差结构。我们证明嵌入维度和运行时间保证类似于非量化设置中的 Fast JL。第一个构造实现了 $m=O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log^2(d/δ))$，而第二个构造在 $m$ 的限制下实现了 $m=O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log(d/δ))$。这两种结构都可以在 $O(d\log d)$ 时间内应用。

papers.title: Think Before You Speak: Enabling Training-Free Latent Communication Between Language Models
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving complex tasks in coding, mathematical logic, and iterative reasoning, especially by coordinating effectively within multi-agent systems (MAS). However, language agents traditionally communicate via text exchange, which introduces a bottleneck in information transfer and adds prefill latency for downstream agents. Recent work proposes that directly sharing the key-value (KV) cache between language models can enable efficient latent collaboration, entirely bypassing standard text-based communication. To enable latent communication between heterogeneous models of different sizes, prior work introduces trained fusion adapters for each model pair, which limits practical deployment. We introduce CacheFuse, a training-free method which demonstrates that augmenting a downstream model with an upstream model's KV cache using linear interpolation consistently enables superior performance than the standalone downstream model can achieve. We systematically analyze CacheFuse across four reasoning and knowledge benchmarks and demonstrate up to 8.6 percentage points higher accuracy compared to single-model baselines and up to 12.2x TTFT speedup compared to text-based communication in multi-model inference.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Efficient Reasoning at COLM 2026

papers.title_zh: 说话前先思考：实现语言模型之间的免训练潜在通信
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在解决编码、数学逻辑和迭代推理等复杂任务方面表现出了卓越的能力，特别是通过在多智能体系统 (MAS) 内进行有效协调。然而，语言代理传统上通过文本交换进行通信，这引入了信息传输的瓶颈，并增加了下游代理的预填充延迟。最近的工作提出，在语言模型之间直接共享键值（KV）缓存可以实现高效的潜在协作，完全绕过标准的基于文本的通信。为了实现不同规模的异构模型之间的潜在通信，先前的工作为每个模型对引入了经过训练的融合适配器，这限制了实际部署。我们引入了 CacheFuse，这是一种免训练方法，它证明使用线性插值通过上游模型的 KV 缓存增强下游模型始终能够实现比独立下游模型更优越的性能。我们系统地分析了 CacheFuse 的四个推理和知识基准，结果表明，与单模型基线相比，准确度提高了 8.6 个百分点，与多模型推理中基于文本的通信相比，TTFT 速度提高了 12.2 倍。

papers.title: Hashrope: A Persistent Data Structure for Mechanisms of LLM Context Management
papers.summary: Serving stacks for large language models manage context through four recurring mechanisms: incremental edits to a growing context, branching and snapshotting for tree search, identification of reusable prefixes for KV-cache reuse, and encoding of repeated segments. Each mechanism is served today by a different specialist structure. We show that all four reduce to a single persistent weight-balanced rope whose every node carries a polynomial hash of its subtree over a Mersenne prime, so that the structure supports logarithmic edits and logarithmic verified content-identity queries at the same time. We validate each mechanism with pre-registered, replicated experiments, then compare against a deployed specialist per mechanism: the Ropey editing library, a faithful PagedAttention copy-on-write block table, and the vendored SGLang radix matcher. On workloads that interleave edits with identity queries, Hashrope is net-superior to Ropey by a factor that grows without bound (369.7x at one million characters). Against the radix matcher on a live vLLM stack serving Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M on four A100 GPUs, Hashrope identifies a one-million-token shared prefix exactly and 1.20x faster, at a context length the dense engine cannot even prefill.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，但证据链尚不足顶会强录。
pros: 将编辑、分支、前缀匹配与重复编码统一到同一持久结构，建模视角新颖

papers.title_zh: Hashrope：LLM上下文管理机制的持久数据结构
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型的服务堆栈通过四种重复机制来管理上下文：对不断增长的上下文进行增量编辑、用于树搜索的分支和快照、识别用于 KV 缓存重用的可重用前缀以及对重复片段进行编码。如今，每个机制都由不同的专业结构提供服务。我们证明，所有四个都简化为单个持久的权重平衡绳，其每个节点都在梅森素数上携带其子树的多项式哈希，因此该结构同时支持对数编辑和对数验证的内容身份查询。我们通过预先注册、重复的实验来验证每种机制，然后与每种机制的部署专家进行比较：Ropey 编辑库、忠实的 PagedAttention 写时复制块表以及供应的 SGLang 基数匹配器。在编辑与身份查询交错的工作负载上，Hashrope 的净优于 Ropey 的程度无限增长（100 万个字符时为 369.7 倍）。与在四个 A100 GPU 上提供 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M 的实时 vLLM 堆栈上的基数匹配器相比，Hashrope 准确地识别了一百万个令牌共享前缀，并且速度提高了 1.20 倍，而上下文长度是密集引擎甚至无法预填充的。

papers.title: Lightweight Scheduling Policies for Continuously Batched LLM Serving Across GPU Architectures
papers.summary: Large language model serving is increasingly limited not only by model size and GPU speed, but also by scheduling during autoregressive decoding, where continuous batching interleaves requests at token granularity as sequences arrive and finish. We study whether lightweight scheduling policies can improve latency-throughput tradeoffs without changing model architectures, kernels, or deploying learned schedulers. We implement a Python/PyTorch continuous-batching testbench with real Hugging Face execution and evaluate eight policies across 1,152 GPU-model-scheduler-workload runs using ShareGPT-derived traffic, six Qwen, Gemma, and Mistral models, and Modal L40S, A100, and H100 GPUs. Scheduler choice changes throughput, TTFT, completion latency, and tail behavior under fixed model, GPU, workload, batch size, and prefill budget. Aging shortest-prompt-first is the strongest practical baseline in many L40S and mixed-workload settings, while oracle remaining-length scheduling shows that job-size knowledge alone is insufficient because batching and hardware effects also shape performance. The custom dataset has been uploaded to Hugging Face.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值较实在，但方法创新性有限。
pros: 问题定位准确，聚焦连续批处理调度这一关键系统瓶颈

papers.title_zh: 跨 GPU 架构连续批处理 LLLM 服务的轻量级调度策略
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型服务不仅受到模型大小和 GPU 速度的限制，而且还受到自回归解码期间调度的限制，其中连续批处理在序列到达和完成时以令牌粒度交错请求。我们研究轻量级调度策略是否可以在不改变模型架构、内核或部署学习调度器的情况下改善延迟-吞吐量权衡。我们实现了具有真实 Hugging Face 执行的 Python/PyTorch 连续批处理测试平台，并使用 ShareGPT 派生流量、六个 Qwen、Gemma 和 Mistral 模型以及 Modal L40S、A100 和 H100 GPU 评估了 1,152 个 GPU 模型调度程序工作负载运行中的 8 个策略。调度程序的选择会改变固定模型、GPU、工作负载、批量大小和预填充预算下的吞吐量、TTFT、完成延迟和尾部行为。在许多 L40S 和混合工作负载设置中，老化最短提示优先是最强的实用基线，而 Oracle 剩余长度调度表明，仅了解作业大小是不够的，因为批处理和硬件影响也会影响性能。自定义数据集已上传至 Hugging Face。

papers.title: Native Dual Pools or Shared Paging? Memory Organization for Concurrent Hybrid LLM Serving
papers.summary: Hybrid attention-SSM serving combines growing attention KV with fixed-size recurrent and convolution state whose allocation units, reuse boundaries, and lifetimes differ. We implement four memory organizations in a modified vLLM runtime: a coarse shared-page baseline (S0), checkpoint-internal recurrent paging (S1), paging with convolution-slot packing (S2), and native dual pools (D0). Nine evaluation questions cover storage costs and serving behavior. The cumulative S0-S1-S2 refinement improves completed-output throughput and tail completion time at the main operating point. D0-S2 performance varies with memory budget, offered load, and admission headroom. Shared-prefix workloads yield larger stepwise gains; gains also persist in a no-sharing control with equal recorded input-work totals. State traces identify recurrent-checkpoint availability as the limit on joint reuse in the tested S2 runs. Extending producer-side checkpoint lifetime increases reusable depth at a fixed page budget. A fresh-seed SHARE/ISOLATE comparison estimates a positive retention interaction, with a primary confidence interval that includes zero. Retained-state continuation correctness remains unresolved. These findings motivate evaluating physical state representation together with request admission and checkpoint lifetime when designing memory management for concurrent hybrid-model serving.
papers.comment: 10 pages of main text, 31 pages of supplementary appendices. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 工程实证扎实，但核心结论统计与正确性仍偏弱。
pros: 围绕混合注意力-SSM并发服务提出了系统化内存组织对比，问题定义贴近实践

papers.title_zh: 本机双池还是共享分页？并发混合 LLM 服务的内存组织
papers.summary_zh: 混合注意力 SSM 服务将不断增长的注意力 KV 与固定大小的循环和卷积状态相结合，其分配单元、重用边界和生命周期不同。我们在修改后的 vLLM 运行时中实现了四种内存组织：粗略共享页面基线 (S0)、检查点内部循环分页 (S1)、带卷积时隙打包的分页 (S2) 和本机双池 (D0)。九个评估问题涵盖存储成本和服务行为。累积的 S0-S1-S2 细化提高了主操作点的完成输出吞吐量和尾部完成时间。 D0-S2 性能随内存预算、提供的负载和准入余量而变化。共享前缀工作负载会产生更大的逐步增益；在具有相同记录的投入工作总量的无共享控制中，收益也持续存在。状态跟踪将循环检查点可用性识别为测试的 S2 运行中联合重用的限制。延长生产者端检查点的生命周期可以在固定页面预算的情况下增加可重用深度。新鲜种子共享/分离比较估计正保留交互作用，主要置信区间包括零。保留状态延续的正确性仍未解决。这些发现促使在设计并发混合模型服务的内存管理时评估物理状态表示以及请求准入和检查点生命周期。

papers.title: To Cache or Not to Cache: Understanding and Mitigating Safety Incompatibility in Cross-Model KV Cache Reuse
papers.summary: Cross-model KV cache sharing reduces prefill computation by allowing a receiver model to reuse prefix KV states generated by a related sender model. Existing methods optimize such reuse for latency and generation quality, but its safety implications remain unclear. In this work, we systematically evaluate this issue across diverse sender-receiver pairs and reuse configurations. We refer to deviations from the receiver's native safety behavior as safety incompatibility. Our study shows that both the direction and magnitude of safety incompatibility depend on the model pair and reuse configuration, with value reuse causing substantially larger deviations than key reuse across all evaluated pairs. Furthermore, we propose VReparo, a technique that learns per-layer and per-KV-head affine maps offline to align reused sender value tensors with their receiver-native counterparts before decoding. Across two model pairs under full KV reuse and the state-of-the-art selective reuse setting, VReparo reduces the average HarmBench attack success rate (ASR) from 57.28% to 39.21% and the average StrongREJECT score from 0.4215 to 0.2163 upon our benchmarks, while retaining an average Time to First Token (TTFT) reduction of 85.62%.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要且方法实用，但证据广度仍不足
pros: 聚焦跨模型KV复用中的安全失配，问题定义清晰且有现实紧迫性
提出轻量离线对齐方法VReparo，在安全指标显著改善下保留大部分TTFT收益
cons: 实验覆盖面与泛化证据有限（模型对、任务与长尾攻击场景偏少），因果解释与鲁棒性分析仍需加强

papers.title_zh: 缓存或不缓存：理解和缓解跨模型 KV 缓存重用中的安全不兼容性
papers.summary_zh: 跨模型 KV 缓存共享通过允许接收器模型重用相关发送器模型生成的前缀 KV 状态来减少预填充计算。现有方法优化了这种重用的延迟和生成质量，但其安全影响仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们通过不同的发送器-接收器对和重用配置系统地评估这个问题。我们将与接收器本机安全行为的偏差称为安全不兼容。我们的研究表明，安全不兼容的方向和程度都取决于模型对和重用配置，在所有评估对中，值重用造成的偏差比密钥重用大得多。此外，我们提出了 VReparo，一种离线学习每层和每 KV 头仿射映射的技术，以便在解码之前将重用的发送方值张量与其接收方本机对应项对齐。在完全 KV 重用和最先进的选择性重用设置下的两个模型对中，根据我们的基准，VReparo 将平均 HarmBench 攻击成功率 (ASR) 从 57.28% 降低到 39.21%，平均 StrongREJECT 得分从 0.4215 降低到 0.2163，同时保持平均首次令牌时间 (TTFT) 减少 85.62%。

papers.title: History Replays Itself: Unleashing Long-Context Capability in Linear Attention
papers.summary: Linear attention promises the efficiency needed for long-context language modelling, yet its fixed-size recurrent state must simultaneously support ongoing computation and preserve information from an ever-growing history. This coupling has reinforced a prevailing view that the state's memory capacity defines the model's long-context capability. We challenge this presumed ceiling: \emph{recurrent computation need not bear the full burden of long-term storage}. We introduce NoteBank, a sparse episodic memory that archives selected text before future queries are known, uses the backbone's native features for writing and addressing, and reads retrieved evidence through its native forward computation via replay. This \emph{training-free, plug-and-play} interface requires no external embedding model, separately trained retriever, or separate neural reader. At one million tokens, it raises Gated DeltaNet's mean accuracy across six RULER retrieval tasks from 1.7% to 70.3%, with no observed significant retrieval degradation from 4K to 1M tokens. This recovery adds $\leqslant$0.025% to analytical FLOPs, with persistent context storage approximately 1/2,600 that of a Transformer's full MHA KV cache at matched width, depth, and precision. Experiments extend from three 1.3B recurrent backbones to Mamba-2-8B and post-trained Qwen3.5-9B, demonstrating gains on LongBench v1/v2 and MemoryAgentBench. Together, these results show that sparse evidence storage and native replay can substantially expand the long-context capability of pretrained linear attention models while retaining the efficiency of recurrent computation.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且结果亮眼，但泛化与开销边界待验证。
pros: 提出训练无关、即插即用的稀疏记忆+原生回放框架，设计简洁且兼容性强
在百万上下文与多模型多基准上报告大幅提升，并强调极低额外FLOPs与存储成本
cons: 摘要未充分交代写入策略鲁棒性、最坏时延与真实端到端吞吐，存在工程落地不确定性
主要证据集中于检索类长上下文任务，对复杂推理与开放域生成的收益边界仍不清晰

papers.title_zh: 历史重演：释放线性注意力的长上下文能力
papers.summary_zh: 线性注意力保证了长上下文语言建模所需的效率，但其固定大小的循环状态必须同时支持正在进行的计算并保留来自不断增长的历史的信息。这种耦合强化了一种普遍观点，即状态的记忆容量定义了模型的长上下文能力。我们挑战这个假定的上限：\emph{循环计算不需要承担长期存储的全部负担}。我们引入了 NoteBank，这是一种稀疏情景存储器，可以在知道未来查询之前存档选定的文本，使用骨干网的本机功能进行写入和寻址，并通过重放的本机前向计算读取检索到的证据。这个\emph{免训练、即插即用}接口不需要外部嵌入模型、单独训练的检索器或单独的神经读取器。对于 100 万个令牌，它将 Gated DeltaNet 在六个 RULER 检索任务中的平均准确度从 1.7% 提高到 70.3%，并且没有观察到从 4K 到 1M 令牌的检索显着下降。此恢复使分析 FLOP 增加 $\leqslant$0.025%，在匹配的宽度、深度和精度下，持久上下文存储约为 Transformer 的完整 MHA KV 缓存的 1/2,600。实验从三个 1.3B 循环骨干网扩展到 Mamba-2-8B 和训练后的 Qwen3.5-9B，展示了 LongBench v1/v2 和 MemoryAgentBench 的增益。总之，这些结果表明，稀疏证据存储和本机重放可以极大地扩展预训练线性注意力模型的长上下文能力，同时保留循环计算的效率。

papers.title: Drift, Then Spread: Learning One-Step Generative Policies for Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Generative policies offer expressive action distributions for online reinforcement learning (RL), but many diffusion- and flow-based policies require costly iterative sampling. We propose DriftSpread, a one-step generative policy based on Drifting for online maximum-entropy (MaxEnt) RL. To incorporate entropy without a tractable policy density, we build on an energy-based view of Drifting and derive critic-guided Drift and entropy-induced Spread from the negative MaxEnt objective. Our method learns these updates sequentially in the same actor, using action regression for value improvement and distribution matching to capture the effect of entropy. The actor updates require neither direct samples from the critic-defined Boltzmann target nor policy-density or score estimation. Under exact fitting with a fixed critic, we prove convergence to the Boltzmann target in the small-step limit followed by the long-time limit. On MuJoCo, DriftSpread achieves the highest aggregate normalized return among all evaluated methods, while outperforming the diffusion- and flow-based baselines in both training and inference efficiency.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但理论与泛化验证仍需加强。
pros: 提出一步采样生成策略，直击扩散/流策略在线RL推理开销痛点
将MaxEnt目标拆为Drift与Spread并在单一actor顺序学习，方法设计简洁
cons: 理论结论依赖固定critic与极限条件，现实训练下可达性和稳健性证据不足

papers.title_zh: 漂移，然后传播：学习在线强化学习的一步生成策略
papers.summary_zh: 生成策略为在线强化学习（RL）提供了表达性的动作分布，但许多基于扩散和流的策略需要昂贵的迭代采样。我们提出了 DriftSpread，这是一种基于在线最大熵 (MaxEnt) RL 漂移的一步生成策略。为了在没有易于处理的政策密度的情况下纳入熵，我们建立在基于能量的漂移视图上，并从负 MaxEnt 目标中导出评论家引导的漂移和熵诱导的扩散。我们的方法在同一参与者中顺序学习这些更新，使用动作回归进行价值改进和分布匹配以捕获熵的影响。参与者更新既不需要来自批评者定义的玻尔兹曼目标的直接样本，也不需要策略密度或分数估计。在与固定批评家的精确拟合下，我们证明了在小步极限和长时间极限下收敛到玻尔兹曼目标。在 MuJoCo 上，DriftSpread 在所有评估方法中实现了最高的总归一化回报，同时在训练和推理效率方面优于基于扩散和基于流的基线。

papers.title: Context-Aware Precision Scheduling for Small Language Models
papers.summary: Small language models (SLMs) used as on-device agents must balance accuracy and latency as their context grows. Mixed precision helps manage this tradeoff by assigning different precisions to weight tensors according to their size and sensitivity. However, these choices depend on the operating conditions, so a configuration selected for a short context may no longer provide the best tradeoff at a longer one. We calibrate a timing model from measurements at different precisions and context lengths, and combine it with tensor sensitivities to choose configurations under a latency or accuracy budget. We argue that fewer bits do not always mean faster execution, so our predictor estimates latency from calibrated execution costs rather than weight bytes alone. Under a latency budget, reading the larger key-value (KV) cache leaves less time for weight operations, leading the allocator to select lower precisions. This gives a schedule of tensor changes that can be prepared before execution. Our runtime follows the schedule while retaining the session's KV cache. We evaluate executed schedules on a laptop GPU, including a longer-context schedule with three weight formats and a tool-use benchmark measuring full response time and correctness. Under an accuracy budget, measured error from a quantized KV cache determines the budget left for weights. The allocator can raise or lower weight precision as this estimate changes. These experiments show where context-aware precision helps and where accuracy recovery remains limited.

papers.title_zh: 小语言模型的上下文感知精确调度
papers.summary_zh: 用作设备上代理的小语言模型 (SLM) 必须随着上下文的增长而平衡准确性和延迟。混合精度通过根据权重张量的大小和灵敏度为权重张量分配不同的精度来帮助管理这种权衡。然而，这些选择取决于操作条件，因此为较短的上下文选择的配置可能不再在较长的上下文中提供最佳权衡。我们根据不同精度和上下文长度的测量来校准时序模型，并将其与张量灵敏度相结合，以在延迟或精度预算下选择配置。我们认为更少的位并不总是意味着更快的执行，因此我们的预测器根据校准的执行成本而不是单独的权重字节来估计延迟。在延迟预算下，读取较大的键值 (KV) 缓存会减少权重操作的时间，从而导致分配器选择较低的精度。这给出了可以在执行之前准备的张量变化的时间表。我们的运行时遵循时间表，同时保留会话的 KV 缓存。我们评估笔记本电脑 GPU 上执行的计划，包括具有三种权重格式的较长上下文计划以及测量完整响应时间和正确性的工具使用基准。在准确度预算下，量化 KV 缓存的测量误差决定了权重的剩余预算。当估计值发生变化时，分配器可以提高或降低权重精度。这些实验表明上下文感知精度在哪些方面有帮助，而准确性恢复在哪些方面仍然有限。

papers.title: The Price of Precision: A Calibrated Cost Model for Mixed-Precision LLM Serving
papers.summary: Choosing a mixed-precision configuration for large language model (LLM) serving trades speed against accuracy. Allocators that use average bit-width or a memory budget as a speed proxy can miss changes in the resource that limits execution. We argue that served speed can be limited by compute, weight loading, or key-value (KV) cache access, depending on the phase, batch size, and context length. A byte-based proxy does not capture all of these costs, so fewer bits do not always mean faster serving. To address this gap, we build a cost model that accounts for the binding resource and use it in two ways. First, as a predictor: given a configuration and operating point, it estimates serving latency using constants calibrated for the model, GPU, and serving stack. We evaluate its accuracy across three hardware classes. Second, as an allocator: we combine modeled time costs with measured per-tensor accuracy costs and use a dynamic program to select a configuration under a latency or accuracy budget. We compare its configurations against byte-aware and sensitivity-only allocation.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要且方案务实，但创新与证据深度中等。
pros: 抓住混合精度中“瓶颈资源切换”这一关键失配点，问题定义准确

papers.title_zh: 精度的代价：混合精度 LLM 服务的校准成本模型
papers.summary_zh: 为大型语言模型 (LLM) 服务选择混合精度配置会影响速度和准确性。使用平均位宽或内存预算作为速度代理的分配器可能会错过限制执行的资源变化。我们认为，服务速度可能会受到计算、权重加载或键值 (KV) 缓存访问的限制，具体取决于阶段、批量大小和上下文长度。基于字节的代理无法捕获所有这些成本，因此更少的位并不总是意味着更快的服务。为了解决这一差距，我们构建了一个成本模型来解释绑定资源并以两种方式使用它。首先，作为预测器：给定配置和操作点，它使用为模型、GPU 和服务堆栈校准的常数来估计服务延迟。我们评估了三个硬件类别的准确性。其次，作为分配器：我们将建模的时间成本与测量的每个张量的准确性成本结合起来，并使用动态程序在延迟或准确性预算下选择配置。我们将其配置与字节感知和仅敏感度分配进行比较。

papers.title: CacheLink: Functional KV Transport for Zero-Prefill Cross-Model Context Handoff
papers.summary: KV caches make long-context serving efficient by reusing past computation, but model switching breaks this reuse and forces the receiver to prefill the context again. We study \emph{zero-prefill cross-model context handoff}: translating a sender cache into a receiver-compatible state so that the receiver can continue directly without prefilling same context. Existing affine transport methods show that receiver KV states can be substantially reconstructed from sender caches. However, through extensive analyses, we find that reconstruction fidelity is a poor proxy for receiver utility. Similar K/V reconstruction errors can lead to substantially different attention patterns, predictive distributions, and downstream accuracy, because conventional reconstruction objectives overlook the query-dependent functional importance of K and V in receiver attention. We thus introduce CACHELINK, which learns a coupled K/V correction through the receiver behavior directly. Across four independently trained sender--receiver pairs and seven evaluation panels, CACHELINK improves the equal-weight mean over all methods for every pair. In matched diagnostics, CACHELINK changes K/V squared error by less than 0.4% while substantially changing receiver attention and next-token behavior. At 32K context, it reduces handoff latency by up to $7.27\times$ relative to receiver re-prefill. Our findings verify that reconstruction fidelity alone is insufficient and that preserving the receiver computation induced by the transported cache is important for effective cross-model KV transport.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要、思路新颖，但证据深度仍有限。
pros: 提出零预填跨模型上下文交接设定，工程与研究价值高
指出重建误差与实用效果脱钩，并以行为导向校正显著提升时延与效果

papers.title_zh: CacheLink：用于零预填充跨模型上下文切换的功能性 KV 传输
papers.summary_zh: KV 缓存通过重用过去的计算来提高长上下文服务的效率，但模型切换破坏了这种重用并迫使接收器再次预填充上下文。我们研究\emph{零预填充跨模型上下文切换}：将发送者缓存转换为接收者兼容状态，以便接收者可以直接继续而无需预填充相同的上下文。现有的仿射传输方法表明接收者 KV 状态可以基本上从发送者缓存中重建。然而，通过广泛的分析，我们发现重建保真度并不能很好地代表接收器效用。类似的 K/V 重建错误可能会导致明显不同的注意力模式、预测分布和下游准确性，因为传统的重建目标忽略了 K 和 V 在接收者注意力中依赖于查询的功能重要性。因此，我们引入了 CACHELINK，它直接通过接收器行为学习耦合 K/V 校正。在四个独立训练的发送器-接收器对和七个评估小组中，CACHELINK 改进了每对所有方法的等权均值。在匹配诊断中，CACHELINK 将 K/V 平方误差改变小于 0.4%，同时显着改变接收者注意力和下一个令牌行为。在 32K 上下文中，相对于接收器重新预填充，它可将切换延迟减少高达 $7.27\times$。我们的研究结果证实，仅重建保真度是不够的，并且保留传输缓存引起的接收器计算对于有效的跨模型 KV 传输非常重要。

papers.title: SpecFit: Not All Draft Tokens Cost the Same in Offloaded MoE Inference
papers.summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few experts per token, but when their expert weights are offloaded to host memory, host-to-device (H2D) expert transfers enter the critical path of decoding. Speculative decoding verifies several draft tokens in one forward pass, yet in an MoE model each verified token activates its own experts, so a larger draft tree transfers more experts. Because of this H2D cost, speculative decoding commits several tokens per verification cycle yet is sometimes even slower than autoregressive decoding. Based on this observation, we propose SpecFit, which chooses the verified draft subtree to maximize predicted throughput rather than acceptance length. SpecFit estimates the expected number of committed tokens from draft path probabilities and predicts cycle time from the node count and the per-layer union of the experts the subtree activates; this union is a monotone submodular coverage function, so each node pays only for the experts it adds. An exact search over ancestor-closed subtrees returns the subtree with the highest predicted throughput; run after each draft level, the same search also decides when to stop drafting, and the unmodified target verifies the result. On CNN/DailyMail summarization and a GSM8K subset with Qwen3-30B-A3B, SpecFit decodes 21.6% and 7.0% faster than EAGLE-3 with the same expert cache and 1.97x and 1.72x as fast as vanilla EAGLE-3. Code is available at https://github.com/Chlience/SpecFit.

papers.title_zh: SpecFit：在卸载的 MoE 推理中，并非所有草案代币的成本都相同
papers.summary_zh: 专家混合（MoE）模型每个代币仅激活少数专家，但是当它们的专家权重被卸载到主机内存时，主机到设备（H2D）专家传输进入解码的关键路径。推测性解码会在一次前向传递中验证多个草稿令牌，但在 MoE 模型中，每个经过验证的令牌都会激活自己的专家，因此较大的草稿树会传输更多专家。由于这种 H2D 成本，推测解码在每个验证周期提交多个令牌，但有时甚至比自回归解码更慢。基于这一观察，我们提出了 SpecFit，它选择经过验证的草案子树来最大化预测吞吐量而不是接受长度。 SpecFit 根据草案路径概率估计提交令牌的预期数量，并根据节点数和子树激活的专家的每层并集预测周期时间；该联合是一个单调子模覆盖函数，因此每个节点只需为其添加的专家付费。对祖先封闭子树的精确搜索返回具有最高预测吞吐量的子树；在每个草稿级别之后运行，相同的搜索还决定何时停止草稿，并且未修改的目标验证结果。在 CNN/DailyMail 摘要和带有 Qwen3-30B-A3B 的 GSM8K 子集上，SpecFit 的解码速度比具有相同专家缓存的 EAGLE-3 快 21.6% 和 7.0%，比普通 EAGLE-3 快 1.97 倍和 1.72 倍。代码可在 https://github.com/Chlience/SpecFit 获取。

papers.title: E8 Lattice Key Quantization for Low-Bit KV-Cache Compression
papers.summary: Compressing the key-value (KV) cache is essential for serving long-context large language models (LLMs) under memory constraints. While current scalar quantization methods achieve significant compression, they typically face a quality-fidelity trade-off, either suffering from performance instability at 2-bit precision or necessitating 3-bit keys to maintain model quality. In this work, we demonstrate that a uniform low-bit k2v2 configuration (2-bit keys and 2-bit values) can preserve near-baseline quality by using vector quantization (VQ) based on the $E_8$ lattice for KV keys. We show that structured VQ exploits correlations across adjacent dimensions to achieve signal-to-quantization-noise ratios (SQNR) higher than those of independent scalar quantization at the same key payload rate. To ensure practical utility, we adapt a table-based asymmetric scoring algorithm that avoids explicit codebook dequantization during attention computation and preserves decode-throughput parity with scalar baselines. Across five LLM families, our $E_8$ k2v2 approach yields \textasciitilde$6\times$ KV compression, roughly 20\% smaller than scalar k3v2 (3-bit keys and 2-bit values), while retaining near-baseline long-context perplexity. In our full-suite perplexity evaluation, $E_8$ improves over scalar k3v2 in 80\% of model--dataset--context settings. These results indicate that $E_8$ lattice VQ improves quality per byte while keeping throughput at parity, suggesting that structured key quantization is a useful primitive for KV-compression stacks. Overall, our work provides a low-overhead primitive for expanding the quality-memory frontier in long-context LLM inference.

papers.title_zh: 用于低位 KV 缓存压缩的 E8 点阵密钥量化
papers.summary_zh: 压缩键值 (KV) 缓存对于在内存限制下提供长上下文大语言模型 (LLM) 至关重要。虽然当前的标量量化方法实现了显着的压缩，但它们通常面临质量保真度权衡，要么遭受 2 位精度的性能不稳定，要么需要 3 位密钥来维持模型质量。在这项工作中，我们证明了统一的低位 k2v2 配置（2 位密钥和 2 位值）可以通过使用基于 KV 键的 $E_8$ 晶格的矢量量化 (VQ) 来保持接近基线的质量。我们表明，在相同的关键负载速率下，结构化 VQ 利用相邻维度之间的相关性来实现比独立标量量化更高的信号量化噪声比 (SQNR)。为了确保实用性，我们采用了基于表的非对称评分算法，该算法避免了注意力计算期间的显式码本反量化，并保留了与标量基线的解码吞吐量奇偶性。在五个 LLM 系列中，我们的 $E_8$ k2v2 方法产生 \textasciitilde$6\times$ KV 压缩，比标量 k3v2（3 位键和 2 位值）小大约 20\%，同时保留接近基线的长上下文困惑度。在我们的全套困惑度评估中，$E_8$ 在 80% 的模型-数据集-上下文设置中比标量 k3v2 有所改进。这些结果表明 $E_8$ 点阵 VQ 提高了每字节的质量，同时保持奇偶校验的吞吐量，这表明结构化密钥量化对于 KV 压缩堆栈来说是一个有用的原语。总的来说，我们的工作提供了一个低开销的原语，用于扩展长上下文 LLM 推理中的质量内存前沿。

papers.title: Compositional Performance Modeling of LLM Inference Clusters with Hierarchical KV Caching
papers.summary: Design-space exploration of LLM inference clusters requires predicting how hardware and serving policies interact with hierarchical key-value (KV) caching. Isolated operation profiles alone do not determine cluster latency: reuse changes computational demand, while KV location, capacity, and contention govern execution order. We present a compositional discrete-event simulator based on separating local service costs from shared resource and KV availability. Compute and transfer models calibrated on one-prefill/one-decode (1P-1D) deployments are reused across compatible workers, enabling policy and topology comparisons without per-configuration latency fitting. Validation against SGLang covers Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B on 1P-1D and 3P-1D clusters. Mean request end-to-end latency error is 1.34% for question answering and 6.36% for captured coding sessions, measured as mean absolute percentage error. CPU simulation reduces replay turnaround by 15.33 times on average; real replay includes prescribed arrival gaps. Measured session-affinity and simulated retention studies demonstrate how the framework guides policy selection by predicting the joint effects on computation, latency, and KV occupancy.

papers.title_zh: 具有分层 KV 缓存的 LLM 推理集群的组合性能建模
papers.summary_zh: LLM 推理集群的设计空间探索需要预测硬件和服务策略如何与分层键值 (KV) 缓存交互。单独的操作配置文件并不能决定集群延迟：重用会改变计算需求，而 KV 位置、容量和争用则控制执行顺序。我们提出了一种基于将本地服务成本与共享资源和 KV 可用性分离的组合离散事件模拟器。在一次预填充/一次解码 (1P-1D) 部署上校准的计算和传输模型可在兼容的工作线程之间重复使用，从而无需按配置进行延迟拟合即可进行策略和拓扑比较。针对 SGLang 的验证涵盖 1P-1D 和 3P-1D 集群上的 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-32B。以平均绝对百分比误差衡量，问答的平均请求端到端延迟误差为 1.34%，捕获的编码会话的平均请求端到端延迟误差为 6.36%。 CPU模拟平均减少重放周转时间15.33次；真实重播包括规定的到达间隙。测量的会话亲和力和模拟保留研究展示了该框架如何通过预测对计算、延迟和 KV 占用率的联合影响来指导策略选择。

papers.title: SAFE-KV: Causal Suffix Repair for Behavior-Preserving Non-Prefix KV Cache Reuse in RAG
papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) reuses the same documents across many requests, making non-prefix KV-cache reuse attractive. Yet a cached document state is not reusable text: it is a context-conditioned causal state whose keys and values depend on the prefix, position, and preceding documents under which it was computed. We formulate non-prefix KV reuse as a behavior-preservation problem with full prefill on the exact prompt as the reference, and introduce SAFE-KV, which repairs a composed cache by re-encoding the causal suffix from a selected start document. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, prefix-conditioned composition preserves only 47.2% of HotpotQA-500 and 37.8% of 2Wiki-500 full-prefill answers; SAFE-KV with risk-guided K2 selection restores 99.8%/98.4% (donor-copy protocol) and 100.0%/98.4% with actual suffix forwarding. Document-only and fixed-window repairs recover far less, because the document states after the repaired region keep histories that omit it. Reuse without repair is exact up to four documents and degrades at sixteen, where suffix repair recovers 98-100%. Faithful repair re-encodes most of the context, so in a single-request L40S study SAFE-KV's operating rule serves every workload by full prefill. SAFE-KV thus establishes the causal-state contract for non-prefix reuse and a validated repair mechanism that meets it.
papers.comment: Accepted to Findings of AACL-IJCNLP 2026. 36 pages, 5 figures, 33 tables. Code: https://github.com/XingjianZhang-dev/safe-kv

papers.title_zh: SAFE-KV：RAG 中行为保留非前缀 KV 缓存重用的因果后缀修复
papers.summary_zh: 检索增强生成 (RAG) 在多个请求中重用相同的文档，这使得非前缀 KV 缓存重用具有吸引力。然而，缓存的文档状态不是可重用的文本：它是上下文条件的因果状态，其键和值取决于计算它时的前缀、位置和先前文档。我们将非前缀 KV 重用制定为行为保留问题，以精确提示上的完全预填充作为参考，并引入 SAFE-KV，它通过从选定的起始文档中重新编码因果后缀来修复组合缓存。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上，前缀条件组合仅保留了 47.2% 的 HotpotQA-500 和 37.8% 的 2Wiki-500 完整预填充答案；具有风险引导 K2 选择的 SAFE-KV 可恢复 99.8%/98.4%（捐赠者复制协议），并在实际后缀转发时恢复 100.0%/98.4%。仅文档修复和固定窗口修复的恢复要少得多，因为文档指出修复后的区域保留了省略它的历史记录。无需修复即可重用最多四个文档，并在十六个文档时降级，其中后缀修复可恢复 98-100%。忠实修复会重新编码大部分上下文，因此在单请求 L40S 研究中，SAFE-KV 的操作规则通过完全预填充来服务于每个工作负载。因此，SAFE-KV 建立了非前缀重用的因果状态契约以及满足该契约的经过验证的修复机制。

papers.title: Swarm Telepathy: Prefill-Free KV-Cache Transfer Across Families
papers.summary: LLM multi-agent systems split work across agents that communicate through text. An agent summarizes its findings, another agent receives the text. This constrains communication to discrete tokens and costs redundant compute, limiting bandwidth and capabilities of multi-agent systems. Recent works demonstrate KV-cache transfer between LLMs but they either require the LLMs to be within the same family or cannot function across context, thus requiring the receiver to prefill text. We present SwaT (Swarm Telepathy), the first cross-family KV-cache transfer method that allows prefill-free communication in multi-family multi-agent systems. In an agent-to-agent communication setting, combining SwaT with recent advances in KV-cache compaction beats text-to-text communication in both accuracy and speed, with a mean of $40\%$ higher accuracy and a mean of $4\times$ faster wall-clock time. Experiments show SwaT achieves high performance on 17 benchmarks across 12 LLMs and 6 families. Additionally, given a sender Vision-Language Model (VLM), SwaT is able to transfer the vision capabilities to a text-only receiver LLM exceeding text-to-text communication despite SwaT being trained on text-only data. SwaT keeps both sender and receiver models frozen without fine-tuning and only requires $<50M$ tokens and $<1$ GPU-day to train.

papers.title_zh: Swarm Telepathy：跨家庭的免预填充 KV 缓存传输
papers.summary_zh: LLM 多代理系统将工作分配给通过文本进行通信的代理。一名特工总结其发现，另一名特工接收文本。这限制了与离散令牌的通信并增加了冗余计算成本，从而限制了多代理系统的带宽和功能。最近的工作演示了 LLM 之间的 KV 缓存传输，但它们要么要求 LLM 位于同一族内，要么无法跨上下文运行，因此要求接收者预先填充文本。我们提出了 SwaT（Swarm Telepathy），这是第一个跨系列 KV 缓存传输方法，允许在多系列多代理系统中进行无预填充通信。在代理到代理的通信设置中，将 SwaT 与 KV 缓存压缩的最新进展相结合，在准确性和速度上都优于文本到文本通信，准确度平均提高 40\%$，挂钟时间平均加快 $4\times$。实验表明，SwaT 在 12 个法学硕士和 6 个系列的 17 个基准测试中实现了高性能。此外，给定发送者视觉语言模型 (VLM)，尽管 SwaT 接受了纯文本数据的训练，但 SwaT 仍能够将视觉功能传输到纯文本接收者 LLM，超越文本到文本通信。 SwaT 无需微调即可保持发送方和接收方模型的冻结，并且仅需要 <5000 万美元的代币和 <1$ GPU 天的训练费用。

papers.title: GateSight: Recurrent Memory Anticipates Attention Memory for Query-Agnostic KV Eviction in Hybrid LLMs
papers.summary: Hybrid language models interleave Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers, whose recurrent memory has a fixed size, with full-attention layers, whose key-value (KV) cache grows with the context and dominates serving memory. In this paper, we ask whether the recurrent memory already knows what the attention memory will need. We first show that which GDN heads of Qwen3.8-27B keep long memories is fixed by the weights rather than by the document. Next, we define the future utility of a KV entry by how much removing it changes the attention output over the model's own continuations, and find that the write gate, decay and write magnitude that GDN layers emit during prefill anticipate this utility before any query is seen. Because the relation is spread across many GDN heads and layers, and a linear map recovers its trend but less of its high-utility tail than a nonlinear one, we propose GateSight, which learns it with lightweight per-head multilayer perceptrons that read these signals and no attention score. Their predicted utility decides which entries each attention layer keeps, and how much each layer keeps is set by the model's native attention output gate, whose mean differs by more than an order of magnitude across layers. Finally, at serving time, GateSight scores the cache once after prefill and physically releases discarded KV entries. Experimental results on SCBench and RULER-4096 with Qwen3.8-27B and, with the same recipe, the sparse-attention model Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, up to the 262K-token limit of the models, show that with a tenth of the attention KV cache, GateSight is the most accurate of five query-agnostic methods on three of the four model-benchmark pairs and leads KVzip on all four, by 9.5 to 47.2 points. Notably, it scores a full-length context with negligible overhead relative to prefill.

papers.title_zh: GateSight：循环内存预测混合 LLM 中与查询无关的 KV 驱逐的注意力内存
papers.summary_zh: 混合语言模型将门控 DeltaNet (GDN) 层（其循环内存具有固定大小）与全注意力层（其键值 (KV) 缓存随上下文增长并主导服务内存）交织在一起。在本文中，我们询问循环记忆是否已经知道注意力记忆需要什么。我们首先表明 Qwen3.8-27B 的哪些 GDN 头保留长记忆是由权重而不是由文档决定的。接下来，我们通过删除 KV 条目对模型自身延续的注意力输出的改变程度来定义 KV 条目的未来效用，并发现 GDN 层在预填充期间发出的写入门、衰减和写入幅度在看到任何查询之前就预测了该效用。由于这种关系分布在许多 GDN 头和层中，并且线性图恢复了其趋势，但比非线性图恢复了其高效用尾部的情况，因此我们提出了 GateSight，它使用轻量级的每头多层感知器来学习它，该感知器读取这些信号并且没有注意力分数。他们的预测效用决定了每个注意力层保留哪些条目，以及每个层保留多少条目由模型的本机注意力输出门设置，其平均值在各层之间相差超过一个数量级。最后，在服务时，GateSight 在预填充后对缓存进行一次评分，并物理释放丢弃的 KV 条目。使用 Qwen3.8-27B 在 SCBench 和 RULER-4096 上进行的实验结果，以及使用相同配方的稀疏注意力模型 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，直至模型的 262K 令牌限制，表明使用十分之一的注意力 KV 缓存，GateSight 是在四个模型基准对中的三个上的五种查询不可知方法中最准确的，并且在所有四个模型基准对上领先 KVzip 9.5至47.2分。值得注意的是，它获得了完整的上下文，相对于预填充来说，开销可以忽略不计。

papers.title: Accelerating Cross-Model LLM Inference via Attention Map Reuse
papers.summary: LLM-augmented data workflows often involve multiple heterogeneous models operating over substantial shared context, such as schemas, tool specifications, interaction history, and intermediate results. Although prefix caching can reduce prefilling overhead, existing approaches are largely limited to reuse within the same model because KV states are tightly coupled to model-specific architectures. We present MapFlow, a system for efficient heterogeneous LLM serving via cross-model attention map reuse. Instead of reusing KV states, MapFlow reuses attention maps, which capture token dependency patterns and are more transferable across models. To enable efficient and accurate reuse, we combine partial recomputation with lightweight linear translation across layers and heads. To make attention reuse practical for long contexts, we further introduce block-level sparse compression and a fused retrieval kernel. Experiments show that MapFlow reduces prefilling latency and improves end-to-end serving efficiency while preserving generation quality across heterogeneous model pairs and multi-turn routing workloads. These results suggest that attention maps provide an effective reusable state for heterogeneous LLM serving, especially in prefix-heavy data workflows. Our code is available: https://github.com/PKU-DAIR/MapFlow.

quality.verdict: 选题有价值且思路新颖，但证据仍偏系统实证。

papers.title_zh: 通过注意力图重用加速跨模型 LLM 推理
papers.summary_zh: LLM 增强数据工作流程通常涉及在大量共享上下文（例如模式、工具规范、交互历史记录和中间结果）上运行的多个异构模型。尽管前缀缓存可以减少预填充开销，但现有方法很大程度上仅限于在同一模型中重用，因为 KV 状态与特定于模型的架构紧密耦合。我们提出了 MapFlow，这是一个通过跨模型注意力图重用提供高效异构 LLM 服务的系统。 MapFlow 没有重复使用 KV 状态，而是重复使用注意力图，它捕获标记依赖模式并且更容易跨模型转移。为了实现高效、准确的重用，我们将部分重新计算与跨层和头的轻量级线性平移相结合。为了使注意力重用在长上下文中实用，我们进一步引入了块级稀疏压缩和融合检索内核。实验表明，MapFlow 减少了预填充延迟并提高了端到端服务效率，同时保持了异构模型对和多轮路由工作负载的生成质量。这些结果表明，注意力图为异构 LLM 服务提供了有效的可重用状态，尤其是在前缀较多的数据工作流程中。我们的代码可用：https://github.com/PKU-DAIR/MapFlow。

papers.title: Vesta: Queueing-Aware LLM Scheduling for Real-World Workloads
papers.summary: Agentic applications generate multi-turn sequences of LLM requests, with each new turn extending the context accumulated from prior interactions and tool calls. Prefix caching reuses the KV cache of earlier turns and avoids redundant prefill, but routing every turn to its cache-affine instance can create severe local queues while capacity remains idle elsewhere. Remote KV cache access relaxes this tension, yet migrating execution adds transfer work and is harmful when the cluster is already congested. Thus, deciding where to execute a request requires reasoning jointly about cache locality, queueing, and the current operating point of the cluster. We present Vesta, a queueing-aware scheduler for distributed agentic LLM serving. Vesta assigns each session a stable holder for its authoritative KV cache while independently selecting an executor for every request. Grounded in classical queueing theory, its objective accounts for backlog, reusable prefixes, KV cache transfer, and the queueing externality of additional service demand; it migrates execution to recover idle capacity when beneficial and favors placements that add the least prefill and transfer work as congestion rises. Vesta also migrates reusable prefixes across length buckets to avoid cold starts. On real-world agentic workloads, Vesta improves throughput by 14.0\% and reduces mean TTFT by 57.8\% over the state-of-the-art scheduler in a PD-colocated deployment. In PD-disaggregated deployments, it reduces mean TTFT by up to 18.1\% and P99 TTFT by up to 29.0\% at matched throughput.

papers.title_zh: Vesta：针对实际工作负载的队列感知 LLM 调度
papers.summary_zh: 代理应用程序生成 LLM 请求的多轮序列，每个新轮次都会扩展从先前交互和工具调用中积累的上下文。前缀缓存重用早期轮次的 KV 缓存并避免冗余预填充，但将每个轮次路由到其缓存仿射实例可能会创建严重的本地队列，而其他地方的容量仍处于闲置状态。远程 KV 缓存访问缓解了这种压力，但迁移执行会增加传输工作，并且在集群已经拥塞时是有害的。因此，决定在哪里执行请求需要联合推理缓存位置、队列和集群的当前操作点。我们推出了 Vesta，一个用于分布式代理 LLM 服务的队列感知调度程序。 Vesta 为每个会话分配一个稳定的持有者来保存其权威的 KV 缓存，同时为每个请求独立选择一个执行器。基于经典排队理论，其目标考虑了积压、可重用前缀、KV 缓存传输以及额外服务需求的排队外部性；它会在有利时迁移执行以恢复闲置容量，并有利于在拥塞加剧时增加最少预填充和传输工作的布局。 Vesta 还跨长度桶迁移可重用前缀，以避免冷启动。在现实世界的代理工作负载上，与 PD 共置部署中最先进的调度程序相比，Vesta 将吞吐量提高了 14.0%，并将平均 TTFT 降低了 57.8%。在 PD 分解部署中，在匹配的吞吐量下，它可将平均 TTFT 降低高达 18.1%，将 P99 TTFT 降低高达 29.0%。

papers.title: Iterate on an LLM, Serve on an SLM
papers.summary: As frontier LLMs gain more capabilities, the cost to run them also goes up. At the same time, small language models (SLMs) also gain more capabilities but have largely been able to keep their cost stable, offering 5-40 times cheaper inference for the narrow, repetitive subtasks that agents decompose work into. However, the standing limiting factor is getting the correct behavior out of a small model in a fast, efficient, and economical way. Unfortunately, in most cases, zero-shot small models fail narrow production tasks. Furthermore, retraining one every time the behavior changes is too slow to iterate on. We propose doing both in sequence. First, develop the desired behavior in prompt space, on a frontier model, with immediate feedback from live traffic. Then, once the behavior converges, distill the recorded production behavior (not synthetic imitations of it) into an SLM through supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We show a proper use case of this method through a scheduling agent for home-care agencies that fans out a single yes/no safety decision per caregiver-shift pair on GPT-5.4-nano. A LoRA-tuned Qwen3-8B trained on 11.6k recorded production decisions reaches 0.913 agreement, while the teacher (GPT-5.4-nano), re-run on its own recorded prompts, agrees with itself only 72.7% of the time, pointing to the fact that the SLM may also be more consistent. Furthermore, when the two disagreed, a blinded professional scheduler sided with the student 48-29. Finally, we find that the SLM has approximately 2.5 times lower median latency and is a fraction of the cost. We believe this lifecycle of quick building, live feedback, and cheap inference is a blueprint for others building similar systems.
papers.comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET)

papers.title_zh: 在 LLM 上迭代，在 SLM 上服务
papers.summary_zh: 随着前沿法学硕士获得更多能力，运行它们的成本也会上升。与此同时，小语言模型 (SLM) 也获得了更多功能，但在很大程度上能够保持其成本稳定，为代理将工作分解为的狭窄、重复的子任务提供便宜 5-40 倍的推理。然而，长期存在的限制因素是以快速、高效且经济的方式从小型模型中获得正确的行为。不幸的是，在大多数情况下，零射击小型模型无法完成狭窄的生产任务。此外，每次行为发生变化时重新训练都太慢而无法迭代。我们建议按顺序进行这两项操作。首先，根据实时交通的即时反馈，在前沿模型上在提示空间中制定所需的行为。然后，一旦行为收敛，通过监督微调 (SFT) 将记录的生产行为（不是对其的合成模仿）提炼为 SLM。我们通过家庭护理机构的调度代理展示了此方法的正确用例，该代理在 GPT-5.4-nano 上为每个护理轮班对扇出一个是/否安全决策。经过 LoRA 调整的 Qwen3-8B 在 11.6k 条记录的生产决策上进行训练，达到了 0.913 的一致性，而教师 (GPT-5.4-nano) 在其自己记录的提示上重新运行，只有 72.7% 的时间与自身一致，这表明 SLM 也可能更加一致。此外，当两人意见不一致时，一位盲目的专业调度员以 48-29 站在了学生一边。最后，我们发现 SLM 的中值延迟大约降低了 2.5 倍，而且成本只是其中的一小部分。我们相信，这种快速构建、实时反馈和廉价推理的生命周期是其他构建类似系统的蓝图。

papers.title: Dissecting the Carbon-SLO Tension in Geo-Distributed LLM Serving
papers.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) inference is driving a growing share of datacenter carbon emissions. Although carbon-aware scheduling can reduce these emissions in geo-distributed datacenters by exploiting the spatiotemporal variations in grid carbon intensity, the latency-sensitive nature of LLM serving constrains this design space. While prior studies investigate the carbon savings achievable through spatial scheduling, they oversimplify the dynamics of modern inference engines, such as queueing and continuous batching, which strongly shape inference latency. We address this issue by designing and evaluating a latency-centric, geo-distributed inference simulator, calibrated with hardware-grounded latency and power measurements, that reproduces these dynamics and enables the study of carbon savings under strict service-level objectives (SLOs). We then formulate a series of SLO- and carbon-aware schedulers of increasing sophistication, from per-request heuristics to batch-level optimization: (i) a greedy heuristic, (ii) an integer linear programming (ILP)-based scheduler jointly assigning batches of requests, (iii) an iterative ILP-based solution projecting its own assignments back into the load estimates to capture load coupling, and (iv) a facility mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) scheduler pricing the energy of batched requests collectively rather than in isolation. Across three LLMs under MLPerf SLOs and varying system loads, the MILP-based option offers the best carbon-SLO balance, reducing carbon emissions by up to 60% relative to the round-robin policy, with an average SLO violation of 3%. Our characterization further shows that savings grow with the spread of carbon intensity across datacenters and shrink as system load increases, while SLO attainment depends on how frequently schedulers receive datacenters' load updates.

papers.title_zh: 剖析地理分布式 LLM 服务中的 Carbon-SLO 紧张关系
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理正在推动数据中心碳排放量不断增长。尽管碳感知调度可以通过利用电网碳强度的时空变化来减少地理分布式数据中心的排放，但 LLM 服务的延迟敏感性质限制了这一设计空间。虽然之前的研究调查了通过空间调度可实现的碳节约，但它们过度简化了现代推理引擎的动态，例如排队和连续批处理，这强烈影响了推理延迟。我们通过设计和评估以延迟为中心的地理分布式推理模拟器来解决这个问题，该模拟器通过基于硬件的延迟和功率测量进行校准，重现这些动态并能够在严格的服务水平目标 (SLO) 下研究碳节约。然后，我们制定了一系列日益复杂的 SLO 和碳感知调度程序，从每个请求启发式到批次级优化：（i）贪婪启发式，（ii）基于整数线性规划（ILP）的调度程序联合分配请求批次，（iii）基于 ILP 的迭代解决方案将其自己的分配投影回负载估计中以捕获负载耦合，以及（iv）设施混合整数线性规划（MILP）调度程序对批量请求的能量进行集体定价，而不是单独定价。在 MLPerf SLO 和不同系统负载下的三个法学硕士中，基于 MILP 的选项提供了最佳的碳-SLO 平衡，相对于循环策略，碳排放量减少了高达 60%，平均 SLO 违规率为 3%。我们的特征进一步表明，节省的成本随着数据中心碳强度的分布而增加，并随着系统负载的增加而减少，而 SLO 的实现取决于调度程序接收数据中心负载更新的频率。

papers.title: EdgeLLM-Nano: Auditing Polar-Guided Key-Cache Compression and Consistency-Anchored Pruning on a 33.6 MB On-Device Language Model
papers.summary: Deploying language models (LMs) on the edge presents unique memory, latency, and power challenges absent in high-performance computing. KV-cache compression emerges as a promising approach to address these challenges. However, the effectiveness of current KV-cache compression methods has not been thoroughly examined on edge devices. Moreover, we show that existing evaluation methods do not always involve the KV-cache under test. We propose EdgeLLM-Nano, a measurement study of KV-cache compression using a nano-scale decoder-only LM (transformer) testbed that has 8.39M parameters, i.e., 33.6 MB, to enable end-to-end examination of each backend, seed, and power sample. Our results give a negative verdict for a polar-guided key-cache quantizer (round-to-nearest (RTN) control causes an order of magnitude less damage), as well as a consistency-anchored progressive weight pruner (one-shot magnitude-based pruning performs as well as, if not better). We also introduce Long-Context Decode Fidelity (LCDF) evaluation, a token-by-token examination of teacher-forced log-losses using the KV-cache under test. Unlike perplexity that gives the same 5.461 score to all methods, LCDF distinguishes different KV-cache compression backends thanks to its paired statistics across seeds and effect sizes. Our companion Raspberry Pi 5 measurement shows all compression backends we tested to be less energy-efficient per token compared to uncompressed FP16 inference. Except for KIVI that is close to lossless in terms of LCDF, our findings indicate KV-cache compression can be improved. LCDF offers a simple and effective way of shedding light on KV-cache compression methods, whose negative impacts have been overlooked by perplexity.

papers.title_zh: EdgeLLM-Nano：在 33.6 MB 设备上语言模型上审核 Polar 引导的密钥缓存压缩和一致性锚定修剪
papers.summary_zh: 在边缘部署语言模型 (LM) 会带来高性能计算中所不存在的独特内存、延迟和功耗挑战。 KV 缓存压缩成为解决这些挑战的一种有前景的方法。然而，当前 KV 缓存压缩方法的有效性尚未在边缘设备上得到彻底检验。此外，我们表明现有的评估方法并不总是涉及测试中的 KV 缓存。我们提出了 EdgeLLM-Nano，这是一项 KV 缓存压缩的测量研究，使用仅纳米级解码器的 LM（变压器）测试台，该测试台具有 8.39M 参数（即 33.6 MB），以便能够对每个后端、种子和功率样本进行端到端检查。我们的结果对极坐标引导的键缓存量化器（舍入到最近（RTN）控制造成的损害少一个数量级）以及一致性锚定的渐进权重剪枝器（基于幅度的一次性剪枝的效果即使不是更好）也给出了否定的结论。我们还引入了长上下文解码保真度 (LCDF) 评估，这是使用测试中的 KV 缓存对教师强制的日志损失进行逐个令牌检查的方法。与 Perplexity 为所有方法给出相同的 5.461 分数不同，LCDF 凭借其种子和效果大小的配对统计数据来区分不同的 KV 缓存压缩后端。我们的配套 Raspberry Pi 5 测量结果显示，与未压缩的 FP16 推理相比，我们测试的所有压缩后端的每个令牌的能效较低。除了 KIVI 在 LCDF 方面接近无损外，我们的研究结果表明 KV 缓存压缩还可以改进。 LCDF 提供了一种简单而有效的方法来阐明 KV 缓存压缩方法，其负面影响已被困惑所忽视。

papers.title: KV4-RL: Unlocking Faster Asynchronous Rollouts for RLVR with INT4 KV Cache Quantization
papers.summary: Asynchronous rollout improves the efficiency of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) by reducing under-utilization during long-tail generation. Sustained concurrency also concentrates context processing into fewer decode steps, increasing the KV workload per step. We characterize this \emph{KV concentration} and find that KV cache quantization delivers substantially greater acceleration than weight-only and weight-activation quantization in our matched-workload comparisons. However, INT4 KV rollout can degrade learning even with token-level truncated importance sampling (TIS). We propose \emph{KV4-RL}, which combines calibration-free INT4 KV quantization with selective INT8 protection of attention sinks and recent context. Protecting a bounded number of positions reduces sampler mismatch while retaining most of the speedup from INT4. Across 400 iterations of Qwen3-8B-Base GRPO training, KV4-RL achieves $1.80\times$ cumulative rollout speedup and $1.27\times$ cumulative full-iteration speedup over BF16 rollout, reaching $1.97\times$ rollout speedup over the final 50 iterations. Under a common BF16 evaluator, its final six-benchmark mean accuracy is within 0.5 percentage points of BF16-rollout training for both Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base.

papers.title_zh: KV4-RL：通过 INT4 KV 缓存量化解锁 RLVR 更快的异步部署
papers.summary_zh: 异步推出通过减少长尾生成过程中的利用率不足，提高了具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）的效率。持续并发还将上下文处理集中到更少的解码步骤中，从而增加了每个步骤的 KV 工作负载。我们描述了这个 \emph{KV 浓度}，并发现在我们的匹配工作负载比较中，KV 缓存量化比仅权重量化和权重激活量化提供了更大的加速。然而，即使使用令牌级截断重要性采样（TIS），INT4 KV 的推出也会降低学习效果。我们提出 \emph{KV4-RL}，它将免校准的 INT4 KV 量化与注意力池和最近上下文的选择性 INT8 保护结合起来。保护有限数量的位置可以减少采样器失配，同时保留 INT4 的大部分加速。在 Qwen3-8B-Base GRPO 训练的 400 次迭代中，KV4-RL 在 BF16 部署中实现了 1.80 美元的累积部署加速和 1.27 倍的累积全迭代加速，在最后 50 次迭代中达到了 1.97 倍的部署加速。在通用 BF16 评估器下，Qwen3-4B-Base 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 的最终六基准平均准确度与 BF16-rollout 训练的误差在 0.5 个百分点以内。

papers.title: Simulate Before You Scale: High-Fidelity LLM Inference Planning Without GPUs
papers.summary: Deploying large language model (LLM) inference at scale requires jointly selecting hardware layout, parallelism strategy, scheduling policy, admission control, and request routing to meet latency and throughput targets. These choices interact: a routing decision that improves cache locality can concentrate load, and an admission threshold that triggers only at saturation allows queues to grow deep enough to degrade critical-tier traffic. Evaluating candidates on GPU clusters is too expensive for iterative exploration, yet existing predictive tools either ignore batching and queueing dynamics or model only fragments of the pipeline. In this paper, we present BLIS, a deterministic, CPU-only discrete-event simulator that models the full inference serving pipeline (admission, routing, scheduling, prefill/decode execution, KV-cache management, and preemption). BLIS pairs analytical basis functions with learned scaling coefficients and overhead terms, fit once globally, to predict step latency without per-model or per-GPU profiling. Across 36 experiments spanning six models and three GPU types, BLIS achieves 6.7% median end-to-end error while running around 200 times faster than real execution. In a configuration search over 420 serving configurations for Llama-2-70B, BLIS identifies a 4-GPU deployment that meets a 300ms mean TTFT service-level objective (SLO), whereas competing tools either require double the GPUs or recommend configurations that fail under load. Two policies evolved entirely in simulation were validated on real hardware and merged into llm-d, a widely adopted open-source platform for distributed LLM serving: an admission policy that reduces critical-tier TTFT P90 by up to 82%, and a flow-control policy that reduces E2E P50 latency by 32-48% on overloaded workloads.
papers.comment: This paper is accepted at ACM SIGMETRICS 2027

papers.title_zh: 在扩展之前进行模拟：无需 GPU 的高保真 LLM 推理规划
papers.summary_zh: 大规模部署大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理需要共同选择硬件布局、并行策略、调度策略、准入控制和请求路由，以满足延迟和吞吐量目标。这些选择相互作用：改善缓存局部性的路由决策可以集中负载，而仅在饱和时触发的准入阈值允许队列增长到足够深以降低关键层流量。对于迭代探索来说，评估 GPU 集群上的候选者成本太高，而现有的预测工具要么忽略批处理和排队动态，要么仅对管道的片段进行建模。在本文中，我们提出了 BLIS，一种确定性的、仅 CPU 的离散事件模拟器，它对完整的推理服务管道（准入、路由、调度、预填充/解码执行、KV 缓存管理和抢占）进行建模。 BLIS 将分析基函数与学习的缩放系数和开销项配对，全局拟合一次，以预测步骤延迟，而无需针对每个模型或每个 GPU 进行分析。在涵盖六种模型和三种 GPU 类型的 36 项实验中，BLIS 实现了 6.7% 的中值端到端错误，同时运行速度比实际执行速度快约 200 倍。在针对 Llama-2-70B 的 420 多个服务配置的配置搜索中，BLIS 确定了满足 300 毫秒平均 TTFT 服务级别目标 (SLO) 的 4-GPU 部署，而竞争工具要么需要双倍的 GPU，要么推荐在负载下失败的配置。完全在模拟中演变的两项策略在真实硬件上得到验证，并合并到 llm-d（一种广泛采用的分布式 LLM 服务开源平台）中：准入策略可将关键层 TTFT P90 减少高达 82%，流量控制策略可将过载工作负载上的 E2E P50 延迟减少 32-48%。

papers.title: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State
papers.summary: State-space models (SSMs) maintain a fixed-size recurrent state, but reading and writing it at every decoding step can bottleneck hybrid models. This eager state management causes large state I/O with low arithmetic intensity, leaves speculative decoding no cheap rollback, and feeds state quantization error into subsequent recurrent updates. We introduce ReplaySSM, which unrolls the recurrence to represent the state as a checkpoint and a buffer of recent SSM inputs. This separates output computation from checkpoint updates. By updating the checkpoint periodically, ReplaySSM avoids state writes on most steps and roughly halves the dominant state memory traffic. Keeping recent inputs also makes speculative rollback a buffer-pointer operation and enables output-only verification without materializing intermediate states. The same separation allows a low-precision checkpoint to serve output computation on most steps while a higher-precision checkpoint serves recurrent updates, so rounding error in the low-precision copy never enters later updates. We implement ReplaySSM in vLLM for Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet. At serving batch size 256, it accelerates standard decoding by $1.20$--$1.47\times$ over a tuned vLLM baseline across four hybrid models, and delivers about $1.8\times$ the throughput of vLLM's speculative decoding on the two 120B-class models. Separate state precisions also reduce output KL divergence and downstream accuracy losses compared with a shared low-precision checkpoint.
papers.comment: 11 pages (35 pages counting references and appendix), 6 figures, 2 tables. Code: https://github.com/Johnny-Liou/ReplaySSM

papers.title_zh: ReplaySSM：缓存 SSM 输入，而不是状态
papers.summary_zh: 状态空间模型 (SSM) 维护固定大小的循环状态，但在每个解码步骤中读写它可能会成为混合模型的瓶颈。这种急切的状态管理导致大量的状态 I/O 和低算术强度，使得推测性解码没有廉价的回滚，并将状态量化误差反馈到后续的循环更新中。我们引入了 ReplaySSM，它展开循环以将状态表示为检查点和最近 SSM 输入的缓冲区。这将输出计算与检查点更新分开。通过定期更新检查点，ReplaySSM 避免了大多数步骤的状态写入，并将主要状态内存流量大致减半。保留最近的输入还使推测性回滚成为缓冲区指针操作，并启用仅输出验证，而无需实现中间状态。相同的分离允许低精度检查点为大多数步骤的输出计算提供服务，而更高精度的检查点则为循环更新提供服务，因此低精度副本中的舍入误差永远不会进入后续更新。我们在 Mamba-2 和 Gated DeltaNet 的 vLLM 中实现了 ReplaySSM。在服务批量大小为 256 时，它比四个混合模型的经过调整的 vLLM 基线将标准解码加速 $1.20$--$1.47\times$，并在两个 120B 级模型上提供约 $1.8\times$ 的 vLLM 推测解码吞吐量。与共享的低精度检查点相比，单独的状态精度还可以减少输出 KL 散度和下游精度损失。

papers.title: Adaptive DHiSparse: Speculative Decoding over a Load-Adaptive KV Hierarchy
papers.summary: Long-context serving runs out of KV memory before the hardware reaches its useful throughput. HiSparse stores history in host memory and fetches only the selected entries, but it uses one cache budget at every load and does not handle draft-model speculative decoding such as DSpark and DFlash2. We present Adaptive DHiSparse, which supports speculative decoding over hierarchical sparse KV and adapts residency to load. It protects the required working set, retains additional history while GPU memory is spare, and recovers the rest through exact fused retrieval. DSpark and DFlash2 keep their proposal and acceptance rules: queries share missing-row retrieval, draft KV uses a window-bounded ring, and verification staging is reused across layer groups. At 100K context and concurrency 128, GLM-5.3 with DFlash2 delivers 793 output tokens/s per decode GPU, 1.45$\times$ HiSparse and 1.27$\times$ non-speculative adaptive serving. Held to the same latency bounds as HiSparse, it sustains up to 4$\times$ the concurrency and 2.3 to 3.7$\times$ the output, depending on the per-token bound. On DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at 500K context and concurrency 512, Adaptive DHiSparse with DSpark delivers 1.85$\times$ the output of resident serving with DSpark. In a load step, optional residency reduces host fetches from 14.2% to 1.4% of selected rows at low load and releases memory under pressure.

papers.title_zh: 自适应 DHiSparse：负载自适应 KV 层次结构上的推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 在硬件达到其有用吞吐量之前，长上下文服务就会耗尽 KV 内存。 HiSparse 将历史记录存储在主机内存中并仅获取选定的条目，但它在每次加载时使用一个缓存预算，并且不处理草稿模型推测解码，例如 DSpark 和 DFlash2。我们提出了自适应 DHiSparse，它支持对分层稀疏 KV 进行推测性解码，并根据负载调整驻留。它保护所需的工作集，在 GPU 内存空闲时保留额外的历史记录，并通过精确的融合检索恢复其余的历史记录。 DSpark 和 DFlash2 保留其提案和接受规则：查询共享缺失行检索，草稿 KV 使用窗口边界环，并且跨层组重用验证暂存。在 100K 上下文和 128 并发性下，带有 DFlash2 的 GLM-5.3 每个解码 GPU 提供 793 个输出令牌/秒、1.45$\times HiSparse 和 1.27$\times$ 非推测自适应服务。保持与 HiSparse 相同的延迟范围，它可维持高达 4$\times$ 的并发性和 2.3 至 3.7$\times$ 的输出，具体取决于每个令牌的范围。在 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 上，上下文为 500K，并发数为 512，采用 DSpark 的自适应 DHiSparse 提供的输出是 DSpark 驻留服务的输出的 1.85$\times$。在加载步骤中，可选驻留可将主机在低负载下对所选行的获取从 14.2% 减少到 1.4%，并在压力下释放内存。

papers.title: Taking Tokenization off the Host for Agentic LLM Serving
papers.summary: Agentic workloads resend long contexts that barely change between calls. Prefix caching now skips most of their prefill, yet every request must still be tokenized in full before the cache can even be consulted. Tokenization, a CPU stage long treated as negligible, becomes the largest part of time-to-first-token (TTFT), and a frontend that tokenizes for a whole GPU fleet limits how many GPUs it can feed. We present GraphTok, a GPU tokenizer that runs the entire encoding pipeline, from pre-tokenization through byte-pair encoding (BPE) merging to token-ID assembly, as one replayable CUDA graph. GraphTok reproduces the reference token IDs bit-for-bit on GPT-2, Llama 3, Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek-V3, and Gemma 3, hands short inputs to a CPU engine where the GPU cannot win, and plugs into unmodified vLLM and NVIDIA Dynamo. GraphTok encodes one million GPT-2 tokens in 1.7-3.2 ms including data transfers, and on Llama 3 it is 4.7-6.0x faster than gigatoken, the strongest CPU tokenizer. On TokTier's own single-request benchmark, it is 2.6-3.9x faster than gigatoken and up to 18.1x faster than TokTier. In vLLM with a cached prefix, it lowers mean TTFT by 2.1-2.4x. The largest gain is capacity. Within a 2 s P99 target, one Dynamo frontend with GraphTok sustains 518 requests/s of 121k-token traffic, the busiest-hour load of 56 GPUs, against 296 with gigatoken and 18.5 with the default tokenizer. Across 121k to one million tokens, this is 1.75-2.5x the load gigatoken sustains, with a P99 up to 64x lower where gigatoken's tail breaks.

papers.title_zh: 为代理 LLM 服务取消主机令牌化
papers.summary_zh: 代理工作负载会重新发送在调用之间几乎没有变化的长上下文。前缀缓存现在会跳过大部分预填充，但在查询缓存之前，每个请求仍必须完全标记化。令牌化这个长期以来被视为可忽略不计的 CPU 阶段，如今成为首次令牌时间 (TTFT) 的最大部分，而为整个 GPU 群进行令牌化的前端限制了它可以提供的 GPU 数量。我们推出 GraphTok，这是一种 GPU 分词器，它运行整个编码管道，从预分词到字节对编码 (BPE) 合并再到分词 ID 组装，作为一个可重播的 CUDA 图。 GraphTok 在 GPT-2、Llama 3、Qwen 2.5、DeepSeek-V3 和 Gemma 3 上逐位重现参考令牌 ID，将短输入交给 GPU 无法获胜的 CPU 引擎，并插入未经修改的 vLLM 和 NVIDIA Dynamo。 GraphTok 在 1.7-3.2 毫秒内编码一百万个 GPT-2 令牌（包括数据传输），在 Llama 3 上，它比最强的 CPU 令牌生成器 gigatoken 快 4.7-6.0 倍。在 TokTier 自己的单请求基准测试中，它比 gigatoken 快 2.6-3.9 倍，比 TokTier 快 18.1 倍。在具有缓存前缀的 vLLM 中，它将平均 TTFT 降低了 2.1-2.4 倍。最大的收获就是容量。在 2 秒 P99 目标内，一个采用 GraphTok 的 Dynamo 前端可维持 518 个请求/秒的 121k 令牌流量，这是 56 个 GPU 最繁忙小时的负载，而采用 gigatoken 的为 296 个，采用默认令牌生成器的为 18.5 个。从 121,000 到 100 万个代币，这是 gigatoken 所承受负载的 1.75-2.5 倍，其中 P99 在 gigatoken 尾部断裂处降低了 64 倍。

papers.title: S$^3$R: Fast and Faithful RL Rollouts via Self-Sparse Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Fast rollout generation for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) requires reducing KV-cache traffic without changing the response groups used for policy optimization. In our profiled RLVR workloads, attention accounts for 72--76\% of autoregressive decoding kernel time. Sparse attention reduces these reads, but sampling directly from a sparse policy changes the response groups used for learning. For group-relative optimization, we show that even exact response-wise reweighting does not generally recover the expected dense-policy update because the advantage of each response depends on the rewards of other group members. We propose Self-Sparse Speculative Rollouts (S$^3$R). It uses sparse attention to propose tokens, then generates responses through full-attention verification and exact speculative sampling. Drafting and verification share the same policy parameter, eliminating the need to train or update a separate drafter. The resulting response groups follow the dense-policy distribution. Under S$^3$R, we characterize speedup conditions and the costs of drafting and verification. We found that dense verification still requires the complete historical KV cache. A KV-aware scheduler therefore limits KV-cache repeated offloading and restoration while maintaining rollout parallelism. % OR thrashing In a matched ablation with an aggressive sparse drafting budget, S$^3$R maintains stable training while direct sparse sampling with training-side correction becomes unstable. On long-context mathematical reasoning, S$^3$R achieves $1.39\times~1.35\times$ the end-to-end training throughput of autoregressive rollouts on Qwen3 model, with comparable task performance.

papers.title_zh: S$^3$R：通过自稀疏推测解码快速、忠实地推出 RL
papers.summary_zh: 具有可验证奖励的长上下文强化学习 (RLVR) 的快速部署生成需要减少 KV 缓存流量，而不更改用于策略优化的响应组。在我们分析的 RLVR 工作负载中，注意力占自回归解码内核时间的 72--76%。稀疏注意力会减少这些读取，但直接从稀疏策略中采样会改变用于学习的响应组。对于组相关优化，我们表明，即使是精确的响应方式重新加权通常也无法恢复预期的密集策略更新，因为每个响应的优势取决于其他组成员的奖励。我们建议自稀疏投机推出 (S$^3$R)。它使用稀疏注意力来提议令牌，然后通过全注意力验证和精确的推测采样生成响应。起草和验证共享相同的策略参数，无需培训或更新单独的起草者。由此产生的响应组遵循密集策略分布。在 S$^3$R 下，我们描述了加速条件以及起草和验证的成本。我们发现密集验证仍然需要完整的历史KV缓存。因此，KV 感知调度程序限制 KV 缓存重复卸载和恢复，同时保持推出并行性。 % OR 颠簸 在具有积极稀疏起草预算的匹配消融中，S$^3$R 保持稳定的训练，而带有训练端校正的直接稀疏采样变得不稳定。在长上下文数学推理上，S$^3$R 在 Qwen3 模型上实现了自回归部署的端到端训练吞吐量 $1.39\times~1.35\times$，并且任务性能相当。

papers.title: DP-MIND: Differentially private memory-guided Long context Inference
papers.summary: LLM-as-a-Service has become a dominant paradigm for accessing large language models without requiring local deployment. However, the process raises severe privacy concerns when user queries may include sensitive or confidential contexts. Differential privacy (DP) provides a principled approach to protecting such inputs, but existing DP inference methods are primarily designed for short- or moderate-context settings and struggle with million-token-scale inputs due to limited context capacity and severe utility degradation under DP perturbation. In this paper, we propose DP-MIND, a memory-guided framework that scales differentially private inference to million-token contexts. DP-MIND enables private long-context inference by locally perturbing the input and processing it chunk by chunk with a compact memory that preserves task-relevant information across the sequence. To make this memory robust to DP noise, we optimize the memory construction policy directly on perturbed inputs using reinforcement learning, guided by both final answer correctness and memory consistency. We further recover perturbation-corrupted answer spans through a local denoising module without exposing the original context to the external model. We provide theoretical privacy analysis of DP-MIND and further conduct extensive empirical analysis across multiple long-context benchmarks with context lengths up to the million-token scale, demonstrating that DP-MIND consistently outperforms existing DP and long-context inference baselines in both scalability and utility.

papers.title_zh: DP-MIND：差分私有内存引导的长上下文推理
papers.summary_zh: LLM 即服务已成为无需本地部署即可访问大型语言模型的主导范例。然而，当用户查询可能包含敏感或机密上下文时，该过程会引发严重的隐私问题。差分隐私（DP）提供了一种保护此类输入的原则性方法，但现有的 DP 推理方法主要是为短或中等上下文设置而设计的，并且由于上下文容量有限和 DP 扰动下效用严重下降，难以应对百万代币规模的输入。在本文中，我们提出了 DP-MIND，这是一种内存引导框架，可将差异私有推理扩展到百万个令牌上下文。 DP-MIND 通过本地扰动输入并使用紧凑内存逐块处理输入来实现私有长上下文推理，该紧凑内存可保留整个序列中与任务相关的信息。为了使这种记忆对 DP 噪声具有鲁棒性，我们在最终答案正确性和记忆一致性的指导下，使用强化学习直接针对扰动输入优化记忆构建策略。我们通过局部去噪模块进一步恢复扰动损坏的答案范围，而不将原始上下文暴露给外部模型。我们提供了 DP-MIND 的理论隐私分析，并进一步在上下文长度高达百万代币规模的多个长上下文基准上进行了广泛的实证分析，证明 DP-MIND 在可扩展性和实用性方面始终优于现有的 DP 和长上下文推理基线。

papers.title: KV-Repurpose: A Testbed for Evaluating Non-Prefix KV-Cache Reuse
papers.summary: KV-cache reuse in large language model serving is commonly limited to exact prompt prefixes, preventing reuse when the same retrieved document appears after different system prompts, conversation histories, or dynamic metadata. We present KV-Repurpose, an open-source, vLLM-based system for developing and evaluating segment-wise KV-cache reuse beyond exact prefixes. The system combines cache-aware segment scheduling, prompt construction, capacity management, workload generation, and runtime monitoring. Experiments on long-context benchmarks show that naive segment reuse largely preserves output quality for single-document question answering and summarization, while exposing clear limitations in cross-document reasoning. Under a Zipfian RAG-style workload in which 20% of requests share a fixed prefix, KV-Repurpose achieves a substantially higher token-level cache hit rate than prefix caching at the same 30 GB cache capacity, 63.9% versus 3.3%, resulting in lower TTFT. Even with 1 TB of cache capacity, prefix caching reaches only a 17.9% hit rate in this workload. Source code is available under the Apache-2.0 license at https://github.com/taiga333/eval-kv-repurpose.

papers.title_zh: KV-Re Purpose：评估非前缀 KV 缓存重用的测试平台
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型服务中的 KV 缓存重用通常仅限于精确的提示前缀，当相同的检索文档出现在不同的系统提示、对话历史或动态元数据之后时，会阻止重用。我们推出了 KV-Re Purpose，这是一个基于 vLLM 的开源系统，用于开发和评估超出精确前缀的分段 KV 缓存重用。该系统结合了缓存感知段调度、提示构建、容量管理、工作负载生成和运行时监控。长上下文基准的实验表明，朴素的段重用在很大程度上保留了单文档问答和摘要的输出质量，同时暴露了跨文档推理的明显局限性。在 Zipfian RAG 式工作负载（其中 20% 的请求共享固定前缀）下，KV-Re Purpose 在相同 30 GB 缓存容量下实现了比前缀缓存高得多的令牌级缓存命中率（分别为 63.9% 和 3.3%），从而导致 TTFT 更低。即使具有 1 TB 的缓存容量，前缀缓存在此工作负载中也只能达到 17.9% 的命中率。源代码可根据 Apache-2.0 许可证获取，网址为 https://github.com/taiga333/eval-kv-re Purpose。

papers.title: CacheFlex: Direct Software-Managed Access to Higher-Level Cache for Scalable Vector Support
papers.summary: Wider vector/SIMD lanes multiply compute throughput, but cache improvements remain challenging. We identify L1 data cache capacity as the most impactful parameter for performance and efficiency. L1 capacity is constrained by pipeline coupling and latency requirements; private L2 offers an order of magnitude more capacity but is inaccessible from software. This work proposes CacheFlex, an ISA and microarchitecture co-design that enables software-managed, direct access to private L2 SRAM by allowing runtime conversion of parts of L2 into a scratchpad memory (SPM). Through a lightweight ISA extension, software explicitly controls data placement and lifetime within the L2. CacheFlex integrates into an out-of-order pipeline with cross-domain memory consistency and OS context-switch support, with merely 2.02% area overhead relative to the L2 in a post-layout 12 nm implementation. We prototype CacheFlex based on the Armv8-A SVE ISA, model it in gem5, and evaluate it using optimized general matrix multiplication (GEMM) kernels with diverse model-derived shapes, FlashAttention-based fused attention, and full-layer workloads from LLaMA-3.2-1B and BERT-Base in the prefill phase. As the vector length (VL) scales from VL = 4 (512-bit) to VL = 16 (2048-bit), CacheFlex's kernel-level geometric-mean speedup and memory-subsystem energy reduction grow from 1.12x and 26% to 1.44x and 40%, respectively, bridging the widening gap between per-instruction data demand and memory performance. On full transformer layers combining CacheFlex with FlashAttention, the design delivers up to 1.78x speedup and 45% memory-subsystem energy savings (BERT-Base, sequence length T=4096, VL = 16; LLaMA-3.2-1B: 1.64x and 38%). CacheFlex is complementary to hardware prefetching, and its benefit grows as vector width and peak compute throughput increase for compute-intensive AI kernels.
papers.comment: To appear in MICRO 2026. 15 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables
